blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal reasoning. We hypothesize that these failures reflect a shared deficit in visual transition reasoning, and test whether this capability can serve as a shared training primitive, one that different models can learn from different supervision sources and reuse across different tasks, with a systematic training recipe. Existing benchmarks document these deficits separately but do not support controlled comparisons across scenes, actions, and reasoning operations. We therefore introduce WOVEN, a training source and benchmark for visual transition reasoning that organizes transition supervision by scene, action, and reasoning type, using diverse, realistic rollouts from video-pretrained generative models: 36,076 examples across 20 scene types, 5 action types, and 8 reasoning types. We first evaluate 38 frontier MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B) and find a substantial and systematic deficit: even the strongest models fall far below humans, and the failures recur across model families and persist with scale. We then train MLLMs at multiple scales on WOVEN and find that they learn a shared capability that transfers broadly: training subsets of only about 2,000 items each collectively improve 22 of 26 external benchmarks by up to 27.3 percentage points, and WOVEN data can replace 30-50% of a task's own training data with comparable accuracy. Controlled comparisons further yield a training recipe for visual world modeling, validated prospectively on held-out benchmarks: select supervision by the reasoning operation it teaches rather than by the actions, scenes, or domains it shows, and prefer larger changes to the visual state for robustness. Our work establishes visual transition reasoning as a reusable foundation for systematic visual world-model training in MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)与空间,内涵,物理,时间推理发生斗争. 我们假设,这些失败反映了视觉过渡推理方面的共同缺陷,并测试这种能力是否能够作为一个共同的训练原始,一种不同的模型可以从不同的监督来源中学习,并跨不同的任务重复使用,并有系统的培训配方. 现有基准分别记录这些缺陷,但并不支持在场景、行动和推理业务中进行有控制的比较。 因此,我们引入了WOVEN,一个视觉过渡推理的培训来源和基准,通过场景,动作和推理类型来组织过渡监督,使用不同,现实的从视频预修的基因模型展开:共有36,076个实例,涉及20种场景类型,5种动作类型,8种推理类型. 我们首先评价了38种前沿的MLLM(例如GPT-5.4和Qune3-VL-235B-A22B),并发现了一个实质性的系统性的缺陷:即使是最强的模型也远远低于人类,失败在模范家庭之间反复出现,并且以规模持续. 然后,我们在WOVEN上进行多种规模的MLLMs培训,发现它们学会了一种共享的能力,可以广泛转让:培训的子集,每个子集只有大约2 000件,使26个外部基准中的22个提高了27.3个百分点,WOVEN数据可以以可比较的准确性取代任务本身培训数据的30-50%。 控制下的比较进一步为视觉世界的建模提供了培训配方,在被搁置的基准上预先验证:通过它所教的推理操作选择监督,而不是通过它显示的行动、场景或领域选择监督,更倾向于对视觉状态进行更大的改变,以保持稳健。 我们的工作将视觉过渡推理确定为在MLLMs系统化的视觉世界模型培训的可重复使用的基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) perform well on visual recognition and language-conditioned reasoning ( Bai et al., 2025b ) , yet remain unreliable on tasks involving visual change, including spatial, physical, embodied, and temporal reasoning ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Chow et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) .
For example, they may misjudge camera rotation, predict outcomes that violate physical constraints, recommend actions that conflict with the task goal, or misorder video frames (Fig. 1 (1)).
Despite their different goals, many of these tasks share a common structure: an action a a links an initial visual state s s to a resulting state s ′ s^{\prime} (Fig. 1 (2)).
Predicting outcomes, inferring actions from observed changes, and reasoning about alternative actions are different inferences over the same ( s , a , s ′ ) (s,a,s^{\prime}) triplet.
We hypothesize that a shared deficit in action-conditioned visual transition reasoning underlies failures across these tasks.
blocks.zh:
多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉识别和语言条件推理(Bai等,2025年b)方面表现良好,但在涉及视觉变化的任务方面,包括空间、物理、体现和时间推理(Wang等,2026年a;Chow等,2025年;Ma等,2026年;Huang等,2026年)仍然不可靠。
例如,他们可能错误地判断相机旋转,预测违反物理约束的结果,建议与任务目标相冲突的行动,或者错误命令视频帧(图1(1)).
尽管它们的目标不同,但许多这些任务都有一个共同的结构:一个将初始视觉状态 s 与结果状态 s → s^{\prime }(图1 (2))联系起来的动作.
预测结果、从观察到的变化推断出行动,以及对替代行动的推理,是对同一(s, a, s ) (s,a, s^{\prime) 三重推论的不同。
我们假设,行动条件下的视觉过渡推理存在共同的缺陷,是这些任务失败的原因。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview. (1) MLLMs fail across spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal tasks. (2) These failures share a weakness: reasoning about how visual states, actions, and outcomes relate. (3) WOVEN generates ( s , a , s ′ ) (s,a,s^{\prime}) transitions with a video generation model, organizes them along controlled axes of reasoning, action, and scene, and turns them into error-typed multiple-choice supervision. (4) Training on WOVEN improves 22 22 of 26 26 external benchmarks; the gains come from a shared primitive that different sources build and different tasks use; and controlled comparisons yield a training recipe: the reasoning operation decides where transfer goes, larger state changes give robustness, and transfer covers transition tasks rather than static perception.
blocks.zh: 图1:概览。 (1) MLLMs在空间、内含、物理和时间任务之间失效。 (2) 这些失败有一个共同的弱点:关于视觉状态、行动和结果的关系的推理。 (3)WOVEN生成(s, a, s') (s, a, s-prime) 以视频生成模型进行过渡,按照可控的推理轴,动作轴和场景轴来组织,并转化为出错型多选择监督. (4)关于WOVEN的培训改进了26个外部基准中的22个22个;收益来自不同来源构建和不同任务使用的共享原始;受控比较产生一种培训方法:推理操作决定转移到哪里,较大的状态变化赋予了强健性,转移涵盖过渡性任务而不是静态感知.

blocks.en: This hypothesis motivates exploring a shared training primitive for otherwise distinct downstream capabilities: rather than improving each capability separately, we ask whether and how visual transition reasoning can serve as a common training target across models and benefit diverse downstream tasks. In this paper, we pursue this goal through four key questions. First, do failures in visual transition reasoning exhibit consistent patterns across model families, and how pronounced are these deficits? Second, can it be learned through transition supervision, and do the benefits extend beyond the training tasks? Third, do these gains arise from separate training components helping separate tasks, or from learning visual transition reasoning that different models can reuse across different tasks? Fourth, and more fundamentally, what governs the downstream transfer and should therefore guide a systematic training recipe: similarities in actions, scenes, or application domains, or the reasoning operation applied to the transition ( s , a , s ′ ) (s,a,s^{\prime}) ?
blocks.zh: 这一假设激励人们探索一种共同培训的原始方式,以建立本来截然不同的下游能力:我们不但没有单独提高每一种能力,我们问视觉过渡推理是否可以以及如何作为跨模型的共同培训目标,并有益于不同的下游任务。 在本文件中,我们通过四个关键问题来实现这一目标。 首先,视觉过渡推理的失败是否在模范家庭之间表现出一贯的模式,这些缺陷有多明显? 第二,能否通过过渡监督来学习,其好处是否超越培训任务? 第三,这些收益是来自帮助完成不同任务的单独培训部分,还是来自学习不同模型可以跨不同任务再利用的视觉过渡推理? 第四,更根本的是,什么是下游转移的规范,因此应该指导一种系统的训练方法:行动、场景或应用领域的相似性,或适用于过渡的推理操作(s, a, s') (s, a, s--prime})?

blocks.en: Answering these questions calls for controlled comparisons that allow us to examine the roles of individual components of the ( s , a , s ′ ) (s,a,s^{\prime}) triplet. Existing task-specific benchmarks document important deficits, but do not readily support such comparisons ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Chow et al., 2025 ; Foss et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . We therefore introduce WOVEN ( WO rld modeling via controllable V ideo g EN eration), a diagnostic and training source that draws on the transition priors of video-pretrained generative models ( Wan et al., 2025 ). Generated rollouts provide known actions and endpoints for forward and inverse supervision, outcomes under alternative actions for counterfactual supervision, and temporally coherent intermediate states for temporal supervision. Organizing this supervision along scene, action, and reasoning dimensions enables controlled studies of learning and transfer (Fig. 1 (3)). The collection comprises 36,076 36{,}076 examples spanning 20 scene types (e.g., kitchen, park, and living room), five action types (e.g., passive physical events, camera motion, and object manipulation), and eight reasoning types across four families (e.g., causal dynamics, temporal coherence, and counterfactual reasoning). We also provide diagnostic splits which cover in-distribution evaluation, held-out scenes, and state perturbations, with error-typed distractors supporting fine-grained analysis of the effects of training (§ 2 ).
blocks.zh: 回答这些问题要求进行有控制的比较,使我们能够审查(s, a, s ) 三重性(s, a, s prime ) 各个组成部分的作用. 现有的具体任务基准记录了重要的缺陷,但并不支持这种比较(Wang等人,2026a; Chow等,2025;Foss等,2025;Cai等,2024;Ma等,2026;Huang等,2026; 因此,我们引入了WOVEN(通过可控V ideo g EN verse)模型(WO rd modeling by controlable V ideo g EN EN verse),这是一个诊断和培训来源,它借鉴了视频预修基因模型的过渡前身(Wan等人,2025年)。 产生的推出为前向和反向监督提供了已知的行动和终点,为反事实监督提供了替代行动的结果,为时间监督提供了时间上一致的中间状态。 沿着场景、行动和推理层面组织这种监督,可以进行有控制的学习和转移研究(图1(3))。 该集包括36,076,36{,}076个例子,涉及20个场景类型(如厨房,公园和起居室),5个动作类型(如被动物理事件,相机运动和物体操纵),8个推理类型,涉及4个家族(如因果动力学,时间一致性和反事实推理). 我们还提供诊断性分解,包括分配评估、搁置场景和状态扰动,有误入分流器支持对培训效果的精细分析(第2节)。

blocks.en:
To examine visual transition reasoning as a common training target, we first ask whether its deficits recur across model families and whether learning it yields gains beyond the training tasks. Through fine-grained evaluation of 38 frontier MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) , and Llama-4-Maverick ( Meta AI, 2025 ) ), we identify recurring failure patterns across model families. These deficits are substantial: even the strongest model achieves only 65.8% accuracy against a 92.3% human baseline. These recurring deficits identify visual transition reasoning as a common target for improving current MLLMs, establishing a training need that extends beyond the weaknesses of any individual model (§ 3.1 ). We then ask whether this capability can be learned and whether the resulting gains extend beyond the training tasks.
Crucially, our empirical results from post-training MLLMs at multiple scales (§ 3.3 ) demonstrate substantial gains: training on the full WOVEN training set raises the in-distribution accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-3B ( Bai et al., 2025b ) from 26.4% to 89.3%, with 88.2% on held-out scenes (§ 3.2 ). The benefits extend to 12 of 26 external benchmarks across multiple domains. Controlled subsets containing approximately 2,000 2{,}000 examples each collectively expand this coverage to 22 of 26 benchmarks, with gains of up to 27.3 percentage points (Fig. 1 (4)).
blocks.zh:
为了将视觉过渡推理作为一个共同的培训目标来审查,我们首先问其缺陷是否在模范家庭反复出现,学习是否在培训任务之外产生收益。 通过精细评价38个前沿的MLLM(如:GPT-5.4 (OpenAI, 2026)),Qune3-VL-235B-A22B (Bai等,2025a),以及Llama-4-Maverick(Meta AI,2025),我们查明了模范家庭反复出现的失败模式. 这些缺陷是巨大的:即使最强模型也仅能达到65.8%的准确度,而人类基线为92.3%。 这些反复出现的缺陷将视觉过渡推理确定为改进当前小额供资和微型企业的共同目标,确立了超越任何个别模式弱点的培训需要(第3.1节)。 然后,我们问是否能够了解这种能力,由此产生的成果是否超出培训任务。
关键是,我们从多种规模(第3.3节)培训后小额供资和微型企业方案获得的经验结果表明,取得了很大进展:关于WOVEN全套培训的培训将Qune2.5-VL-3B(Bai等人,2025年b)的分布精度从26.4%提高到89.3%,在被搁置的场景中为88.2%(第3.2节)。 好处扩展到26个外部基准中的12个,涉及多个领域。 包含大约2,000个2{,}000个实例的受控子集,将这一覆盖面集体扩大到26个基准中的22个,收益可达27.3个百分点(图1(4))。

blocks.en: However, broad transfer alone does not establish visual transition reasoning as a shared training primitive that different models can reuse from different sources in learning different tasks, as the downstream gains could arise from separate parts of the training source, each helping only its own tasks. To serve as a shared training primitive, visual transition reasoning must be a common capability that models acquire from different sources, and the gains on downstream tasks must result from this common capability. We therefore first test whether different sources improve the same capability, and find that every controlled subset improves WOVEN accuracy, including on the action types it does not train on (§ 3.2 ), meeting the first requirement. We then examine whether the downstream gains result from this common capability, by checking whether subsets that improve it more also transfer more. Results show that the more a subset improves WOVEN accuracy, the larger its average gain on the external benchmarks ( r = 0.86 r{=}0.86 ), and that the gains come from visual transition reasoning itself rather than from a generally stronger model or the answer format (§ 4 ). We further test causality by intervening on the training data: replacing 30 30 – 50 % 50\% of task-specific examples with WOVEN under a fixed training budget preserves comparable accuracy (Fig. 3 ; § 4 ), showing that transition supervision can take over part of the training normally supplied by task-specific data. Together with transfer across model scales (§ 3.3 ), these results establish visual transition reasoning as a shared training primitive.
blocks.zh: 然而,光是广泛的转移并不能将视觉过渡推理确立为一种共享的训练原始,不同的模型可以在学习不同任务时从不同来源再利用,因为下游的收益可能来自训练来源的不同部分,每个部分都只帮助自己的任务. 要发挥共享培训原始,视觉过渡推理必须是模型从不同来源获得的共同能力,下游任务的收益必须来自这种共同能力. 因此,我们首先检验不同来源是否提高同一能力,并发现每个受控子集提高WOVEN的准确性,包括它没有训练的动作类型(第3.2节),满足了第一项要求。 然后,我们审查这种共同能力是否产生下游收益,检查改善这种能力的子集是否也进行更多的转让。 结果显示,子集越能提高WOVEN的准确性,其外部基准的平均收益越大(r = 0.86 r = 0.86),而收益来自视觉过渡推理本身,而不是一般较强的模式或答案格式(§ 4). 我们通过干预培训数据进一步检验因果关系:在固定培训预算下,将30个任务特定实例中的50 % 替换为WOVEN(图3;第4段),从而保持了可比较的准确性,表明过渡监督可以接管通常由任务特定数据提供的部分培训。 连同跨模型尺度的转移(§3.3),这些结果将视觉过渡推理确立为共享的训练原始.

blocks.en:
More importantly, our controlled comparisons yield a training recipe for visual world modeling, validated prospectively on held-out benchmarks (§ 5 ). (1) Select supervision by reasoning operation. Surprisingly, supervision that teaches the same reasoning operation produces similar patterns of downstream gains even when the actions differ, whereas supervision that shares only an action type does not (Fig. 1 (4)). The reasoning operation therefore provides a basis for selecting supervision with relevant downstream benefits. Once the operation is selected, (2) choose supervision with larger changes to the visual state for robustness. Supervision whose actions change more of the scene, such as object manipulation, yields larger robustness gains than supervision that only moves the camera. (3) Supervise temporal and agent-driven tasks directly. Transfer does not cross the boundary between the temporal family and the other three reasoning families, nor the boundary between passive physical events and agent-driven actions. (4) Keep dedicated supervision for capabilities beyond state transitions. Transition supervision improves diverse tasks that involve state transitions, but does not necessarily generalize to capabilities such as static perception, which therefore need their own supervision (§ 5 ).
Taken together, our study establishes visual transition reasoning as a shared, trainable primitive and provides a systematic recipe for training it, offering a controlled framework for advancing visual world modeling in MLLMs.
blocks.zh:
更重要的是,我们控制下的比较为视觉世界的模型制作提供了一种培训方法,在预想中根据被搁置的基准加以验证(第5节)。 (1)通过推理操作选择监督. 令人惊讶的是,即使行动不同,教导同一推理操作的监督也会产生类似的下游收益模式,而只分享一种行动类型的监督则不然(图1(4))。 因此,推理业务为选择具有相关下游效益的监督提供了依据。 一旦选择了操作,(2)选择对视觉状态有较大变化的监督,以达到坚固性. 其行动改变更多场景的监管,如物体操纵,产生比只移动相机的监管更大的稳健性收益. (3)直接监督时间和代理驱动的任务. 转移并不跨越时间家族与其他三个推理家族的边界,也不跨越被动的物理事件与代理驱动的行动的边界. (4) 对国家过渡后的能力进行专门监督。 过渡监督改进了涉及国家过渡的各种任务,但不一定概括到静态感知等能力,因此需要自身的监督(第5节)。
综合起来,我们的研究将视觉过渡推理确定为一种共享的,可训练的原始理论,并提供了系统的培训方法,为在MLLMs中推进视觉世界建模提供了控制框架.

blocks.zh: 2个世界

Right: example scenes; restaurant and beach are held out for the scene-OOD test.

blocks.en: We present WOVEN, a training source and benchmark for visual transition reasoning, designed for controlled comparisons of supervision. We first formalize visual transition reasoning in § 2.1 as the theoretical foundation. Then, we define our taxonomy in § 2.2 , which labels every item along three axes, scene, action, and reasoning type, so that supervision can be varied independently along each axis. As real video offers neither controlled actions nor alternative outcomes from the same initial state, and simulators are limited in realism and in scene and object diversity, we generate the transitions specified by our taxonomy with a video generation model , which produces rollouts from specified initial states and actions, and alternative rollouts from the same state under different actions (§ 2.3 ). Finally, we turn the rollouts into multiple-choice items with error-typed distractors and split them into a training set and three test sets (§ 2.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们提出WOVEN是视觉过渡推理的培训来源和基准,旨在对监督进行有控制的比较。 我们首先将§ 2.1中的视觉过渡推理正式化,作为理论基础. 然后,我们在第2.2节中定义了我们的分类法,它按照三个轴线,场景,动作,和推理类型来标注每个项,这样监督就可以沿着每个轴线独立地变化. 由于真实的视频既不能提供控制动作,也不能提供来自同一初始状态的替代结果,模拟器在现实主义以及场景和物体多样性方面都受到限制,因此我们用一个视频生成模型来生成我们分类学指定的过渡,该模型产生来自特定初始状态和动作的推出,以及来自同一状态的不同动作下的替代推出(§ 2.3)。 最后,我们用错误的分心器将推出的软件转换成多选择的软件,并分成一套培训和三套测试(第2.4节)。

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Transition Reasoning
blocks.zh: 2.1 视觉过渡

blocks.en: Given a transition ( s , a , s ′ ) (s,a,s^{\prime}) , where s s and s ′ s^{\prime} are the visual states of a scene before and after an action a a , which may be agent-driven or passive, visual transition reasoning is the process of inferring unobserved component(s) of the transition from its known or observed parts. Different choices of which parts are given or to be inferred define different reasoning operations, each written as a conditional distribution such as P ⁡ ( s ′ ∣ s , a ) P(s^{\prime}\mid s,a) (shorthand for P ⁡ ( S ′ = s ′ ∣ S = s , A = a ) P(S^{\prime}=s^{\prime}\mid S=s,A=a) ). This work considers eight operations in four families (Table 1 ). Appendix A.1 gives the semantics of each operation.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个过渡(s, a, s') (s, a, s-prime}),其中 s和 s' s-prime} 是行动前后的场景的可视状态,可能是代理人驱动的或被动的,视觉过渡推理是推断过渡中由已知或被观察到的部分产生的不可视成分的过程. 对哪些部分给出或推断的不同选择定义了不同的推理操作,每个部分写成有条件的分布,如:P  (s′ s∣ s∣ s∣ s∣ a) (s^{\prime}\ mid s,a) (P⁡ (S′ s′ s∣ s∣ s∣ s= a)) P (S^{\prime}= s^{\prime}\ mid S=s,A=a). 这项工作涉及4个家庭的8个业务(表1)。 附录A.1给出了每次操作的语义.

blocks.en: 2.2 Controlled Axes
blocks.zh: 2.2 受控斧头

blocks.en: We define the taxonomy along three axes and categorize each item accordingly: (1) the scene in which its transition occurs, (2) the action producing the change, and (3) the reasoning operation applied to the transition (Fig. 2 ). Scene type has 20 20 categories, evenly divided between indoor and outdoor environments (e.g., kitchen, living room, park, and beach). Action type has 5 5 categories: one exogenous type, passive physical events (Exo), divided into 8 8 principles from cognitive science ( 3 3 object properties and 5 5 physical events), and four endogenous, agent-driven types: perceptive, that is, camera motion (Perc), inspective, that is, object inspection (Insp), navigative, that is, navigation (Navi), and manipulative, that is, object manipulation (Mani) (Fig. 2 ). Reasoning type instantiates the eight operations of Table 1 , grouped in pairs into four families: forward dynamics (Fwd) and inverse dynamics (Inv) in causal dynamics, counterfactual removal (Rmv) and counterfactual substitution (Sub) in counterfactual reasoning, outcome prediction (Otm) and cued prediction (Cue) in physical modeling, and temporal ordering (Ord) and temporal adjacency (Adj) in temporal coherence. The tables use these abbreviations. Within compatible combinations, each axis can be varied while the other two are held fixed. Category definitions and cognitive motivation are in Appendices B.3 – B.6 .
blocks.zh: 我们按照三个轴来定义分类,并据此对每个项目进行分类:(1) 其过渡发生的场景;(2) 产生变化的动作;(3) 适用于过渡的推理操作(图2. 场景类型有20个类别,均匀分为室内和室外环境(如厨房,起居室,公园和海滩). 动作类型有5个5个类别:一个外向类型,被动物理事件(Exo),分为认知科学的8个原则(3个3个物体属性和5个物理事件),以及4个内向,由物剂驱动的类型:能感性,即相机运动(Perc),检查性,即物体检查(Insp),导航(Navi),以及操纵性,即物体操纵(Mani)(图2). 合理类型即时将表1的8个操作组合为4个家族:前向动力学(Fwd)和逆向动力学(Inv)在因果动力学中,反事实去除(Rmv)和反事实取换(Sub)在反事实推理中,结果预测(Otm)和提示预测(Cue)在物理建模中,以及时间顺序(Ord)和时间相接性(Adj)在时间一致性中. 表格使用这些缩略语。 在相容的组合内,每个轴可以变换而其他两个被固定. 类别定义和认知动机载于附录B.3 – B.6.

blocks.en: 2.3 Controlled Rollout Generation
blocks.zh: 2.3 控制推出生成

blocks.en: We use Wan2.2-I2V-A14B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) to generate rollouts from initial frames and action descriptions, following two construction principles. (P1) World-model isolation. Resulting and intermediate states are produced by the rollout rather than prescribed in the conditioning prompt, so supervision draws on learned transition dynamics. (P2) Counterfactual rollouts. From the same initial state, we generate several independent rollouts under different actions, so that alternative outcomes of the same scene are available. Generation, frame extraction, and quality-control details are provided in Appendix B.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用Wan2.2-I2V-A14B(Wan等,2025年)从初始框架和动作描述中推开,遵循两个构建原则. (P1)世界模范隔离. 结果状态和中间状态通过推出产生,而不是在条件即时规定,因此监督借鉴了学到的过渡动态. (P2)反事实推出. 在同一初始状态下,我们在不同的行动下产生几个独立的推出,这样就可以获得同一场景的替代结果. 生成、取出相框和质量控制细节见附录B.2。

blocks.en: 2.4 Supervision Construction and Dataset Splits
blocks.zh: 2.4 监督建筑和数据集

blocks.en: We build multiple-choice questions from the rollouts, each referred to as an item and is defined on all three axes: its scene and action types are those of the transition it is built from, and its reasoning type (Table 1 ) determines which parts of the transition are given and which part is asked for. Each question is phrased with one of 30 30 templates drawn at random to ensure linguistic diversity. The three distractor options are usually drawn from other rollouts sharing the same initial state, each wrong in a specific way (e.g., the outcome of a different action) and labeled with its error type (e.g., “reversed direction” or “violating gravity”), enabling fine-grained error analysis and statistical attribution beyond overall accuracy. For physical-modeling items, the distractors are produced by an image editor, so the correct option is also passed through the same editor with an instruction to change nothing; a control experiment shows that editing artifacts do not reveal the answer. See Appendices B.9 and D for details.
blocks.zh: 我们从展开中构建出多个选择题,每个被称作一个项目,并在所有三个轴上被定义:它的场景和动作类型是它所构建的过渡的场景和动作类型,它的推理类型(表1)决定了过渡的哪些部分是给定的,需要哪个部分. 每个问题都用随机抽取的30个模板之一来表示,以确保语言多样性。 三种分心者选项通常取自于分享相同初始状态的其他推出,每个选项都以特定的方式(如不同动作的结果)出错,并被标注出其出错类型(如"逆向"或"活出引力"),从而能够进行精细的误差分析和统计归属,超出总体准确度. 对于物理模型项目,分取器由图像编辑器出产,因此正确的选项也通过同名编辑器传递,并附有任何改变的指令;一个控制实验显示,编辑文物不会揭示答案. 详见附录B.9和D。

blocks.en: WOVEN has one training set ( 22,728 22{,}728 ), one validation set ( 2,508 2{,}508 ), and three test sets, totaling 36,076 36{,}076 four-option multiple-choice items (Appendix B.7 ). Each test set differs from the training set in one respect. The in-distribution test set ( 6,228 6{,}228 ) contains new transitions from the same 18 18 scenes as the training set. The scene-OOD test set ( 3,496 3{,}496 ) contains transitions from two held-out scenes, restaurant and beach, following held-out-environment evaluation in embodied AI ( Majumdar et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ) . The state-perturbation test set ( 1,116 1{,}116 ) measures robustness to controlled changes in the initial state: following the logic of contrast sets ( Gardner et al., 2020 ) , each item perturbs one condition of an in-distribution item’s initial state, either its spatial configuration or its appearance, while keeping the action and the multiple-choice question fixed, testing whether a model actually models the state rather than the typical effect of the action (Appendix B.10 ).
blocks.zh: WOVEN有一个训练集(22,728 22{,}728),一个验证集(2,508 2{,}508),以及三个测试集,共计36,076 36{,}076个四可选多选择项目(附录B.7). 每个测试集都与培训集不同。 内部分配测试集(6,228 6{,}228)包含与训练集相同的18个场景的新过渡. 场景-OOD测试集(3,496 3{,}496)包含两个被搁置的场景的过渡,餐厅和海滩,在包含AI的被搁置的环境评价之后(Majumdar等,2024;Cheng等,2025.). 状态-扰动测试集(1,116 1{,}116)测量初始状态中受控变化的稳健性:按照对比集的逻辑(Gardner等,2020年),每个项目扰动一个分配中项目初始状态的一个条件,无论是空间配置还是外观,同时保持动作和多选择问题固定,测试一个模型是否实际模拟状态而非动作的典型效果(Appendix B.10).

blocks.en: 3 Is Visual Transition Reasoning Learnable and Transferable?
blocks.zh: 3 视觉过渡是否能够学习和转移?

blocks.en:
Using WOVEN as an error-typed and shortcut-resistant diagnostic and training source, we ask how far current MLLMs fall short in visual transition reasoning (§ 3.1 ), whether it can be learned from transition supervision (§ 3.2 ), and whether the learned reasoning transfers beyond the training tasks (§ 3.3 ). Throughout, training is carried out in two complementary ways: on the full WOVEN training set, and on controlled subsets, each containing only items of a specified action type and reasoning family and named after the two (perc_causal, for example, holds camera-motion items of the causal family, and insp_cf object-inspection items of the counterfactual family); WOVEN’s training set consists of 11 11 such subsets, each of about 2,000 2{,}000 items.
 The full training set is trained with supervised fine-tuning, and each subset with supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) (Appendix G.1 ), on MLLMs of multiple scales (Appendix G.15 ).
Evaluation uses the three WOVEN test sets and, zero-shot, 26 26 external benchmarks: 22 22 that involve visual transitions, spanning spatial, embodied, physical, temporal reasoning, etc., and 4 4 benchmarks of static perception and general video QA. A benchmark counts as improved when the gain over the base model exceeds 2 2 percentage points.
blocks.zh:
使用WOVEN作为有错误类型并抗捷径的诊断和培训来源,我们询问当前MLLM在视觉过渡推理(§ 3.1)中还有多远的不足,是否可以从过渡监督(§ 3.2)中得知,学到的推理是否转移到培训任务之外(§ 3.3). 在整个过程中,培训以两种补充方式进行:关于WOVEN全套培训,关于受控子集的培训,每个子集只包含特定行动类型和推理家族的物项并按两者命名(例如,perc_causal拥有因果关系家族的相机-运动项目,而insp_cf参考反事实家族的物体检查项目);WOVEN的培训由11个此类子集组成,每个集约2,000 2{}000个.
全套培训用有监督的微调进行训练,每个子集用有监督的微调进行训练(Shao等人,2024年)(附录G.1),内容为多种规模的MLLMs(附录G.15.)。
评价使用三个WOVEN测试集,零镜头,26个外部基准:22个涉及视觉过渡,跨越空间,体现,物理,时间推理等,以及4个静态感知和一般视频QA的基准. 基准在超过基准模型2个百分点时算得上改进。

blocks.en: 3.1 Current MLLMs Show a Systematic Deficit
blocks.zh: 3.1 当前 MLLMs 显示系统缺陷

blocks.en: Table 3: WOVEN test accuracy (%) of Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct after training on the full training set, and gains (percentage points over the base model) after training on each controlled subset. In-distribution results are reported overall, by action type, and on temporal adjacency; bold marks the action type a subset trains on. Results after SFT alone and by every reasoning type are in Appendix G.17 .

blocks.en: To establish the need for training, we first quantify the size and distribution of the deficit in visual transition reasoning by evaluating 38 38 frontier MLLMs on the in-distribution and state-perturbation test sets; Table 2 reports the four strongest against the human baseline. The best model, GPT-5.4, reaches 65.8 % 65.8\% in-distribution accuracy against 92.3 % 92.3\% for humans (the mean of three annotators), and the next three fall between 57.8 % 57.8\% and 63.2 % 63.2\% , a gap that persists across model scales and cannot be closed by scaling alone (Appendix F.2 ). The gap also has a consistent structure across model families: for every model, temporal adjacency is harder than ordering ( 25.3 % 25.3\% – 28.0 % 28.0\% versus 30.8 % 30.8\% – 63.4 % 63.4\% ), counterfactual removal is harder than substitution ( 54.8 % 54.8\% – 66.7 % 66.7\% versus 64.5 % 64.5\% – 76.0 % 76.0\% ), and accuracy drops more under geometric than under appearance changes ( 33.3 % 33.3\% – 62.7 % 62.7\% versus 79.2 % 79.2\% – 95.5 % 95.5\% ), suggesting a systematic deficit in visual transition reasoning rather than an idiosyncrasy of any particular family or training recipe. These results provide a fine-grained baseline for the training study that follows. The model inventory, human protocol, and detailed results are in Table 15 and Appendices C.2 , E , and F ; complementary evaluations of a VGM, V-JEPA 2 ( Assran et al., 2025 ) , and an IGM are in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 为了确定培训的必要性,我们首先通过在分配和状态扰动测试集上评价38个前沿MLLM,量化视觉过渡推理缺陷的大小和分布; 表2报告四个最强者对照人类基线。 最佳模式GPT-5.4达到65.8%的分布精度,而人类的分布精度为92.3%的92.3%(指3个注释员的平均值),接下来的3个下降在57.8%的57.8%和63.2%的63.2%之间,这一差距在模型尺度之间持续存在,无法单靠缩放来弥补(附录F.2). 这一差距在模范家庭之间也有着一致的结构:对于每个模型来说,时间相接比定时更难(25.3% 25.3 – 28.0 – 28.0 – 28.0 – 30.8 – 63.4 – 63.4 – 30.8 – 63.8 – 63.4 – ) ,反事实除去比替代更难(54.8% 54.8 – 66.7 % 66.5 – 64.5 % – 76.0 % 76.0 % 76.0 % ) , 准确度比外观变化更低(33.3% 33.3 – 62.7 % 62.7 – 79.2 % 95.5 % ) , 这表明视觉过渡推理存在系统性的缺陷,而不是任何特定家庭或培训方法的典型。 这些结果为随后的培训研究提供了一个精细的基线。 示范清单、人类协议和详细结果见表15和附录C.2、E和F;对VGM、V-JEPA2(Asran等人,2025年)和IGM的补充评价载于附录B.1。

blocks.en: 3.2 Visual Transition Reasoning Is Learnable
blocks.zh: 3.2 视觉过渡 理性是可学习的

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , supervised fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct on the full training set raises in-distribution accuracy from 26.4 % 26.4\% to 89.3 % 89.3\% , with 88.2 % 88.2\% on held-out scenes. The gains also hold on models of larger scales and different families (Appendices G.15 and I.2 ). Each controlled subset also raises WOVEN accuracy on its own, by 6.1 6.1 to 25.3 25.3 percentage points in distribution, and also on action types it does not train on (Table 3 ), so different kinds of supervision improve the same capability rather than only the action they were specifically trained on. The deficit is therefore learnable as a whole from transition supervision, and the learning generalizes across scenes. The learning is also data-efficient: with about 7 7 hours of generated video, WOVEN post-training yields a larger gain on a spatial-reasoning benchmark than Orca ( Wang et al., 2026c ) , which mid-trains the same backbone on 125,000 125{,}000 hours of video (Appendix G.16 ).
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,对全套培训的Quen2.5-VL-3B-指令进行了有监督的微调,将分配精度从26.4% 26.4% 提高到89.3% 89.3% 89.3% ,其中88.2% 88.2% 在停放场景上。 这些收益还取决于规模较大和不同家庭的模式(附录G.15和一.2)。 每个受控子集还提高了WOVEN的准确度,在分布上提高了6.1-6.1至25.3 25.3个百分点,在行动类型上也没有经过训练(表3),因此,不同的监督方式提高了同样的能力,而不仅仅是它们专门训练的行动。 因此,从过渡监督中可以从整体上学习不足,而学习则跨越了各种场景。 学习也具有数据效率:通过大约7个7小时生成的视频,WOVEN的后培训在空间推理基准上产生比Orca(Wang等人,2026c)更大的收益,后者在12.5万125{,}000小时视频(附录G.16.)上通过同一主干线中游.

blocks.en: 3.3 Learned Transition Reasoning Transfers Broadly
blocks.zh: 3.3 广泛转让

blocks.en: We then examine whether the learned reasoning transfers to other tasks. The full training set improves as many as 12 12 of the 26 26 external benchmarks, with gains of up to 24.0 24.0 percentage points on SAT (Table 5 ). The controlled subsets transfer effectively as well, despite holding only about 2,000 2{,}000 items each: with the best subset chosen for each benchmark, the coverage rises to a remarkable 22 22 of 26 26 , that is, every benchmark that involves visual transitions, and gains reach up to 27.3 27.3 percentage points (Table 5 ; selection and seed checks in Appendix I.1 ). The transfer also holds at scale (Appendix G.15 ) and across model families (Appendix I.2 ). The 4 4 benchmarks of static perception and general video QA do not improve under any training (Table 5 ), so the gains are not due to an overall stronger model or to better multiple-choice answering (Appendix H.2 ). Full scores and evaluation procedures are in Appendices G.13 and D .
blocks.zh: 然后,我们审查学到的推理是否转移到其他任务。 全套培训在26个外部基准中改进了多达12个12个,在SAT上提高了24.0个24.0个百分点(表5)。 受控子集也有效转移,尽管每个集只持有约2,000个2{,}000个项目:每个基准选择最佳子集,覆盖范围上升到显著的22个22个26个,即每个涉及视觉过渡的基准,收益可达27.3 27.3个百分点(表5;附录一.1中的选择和种子检查)。 这种转移还具有规模(附录G.15)和跨模范家庭(附录一.2.)。 静态感知和一般视频QA的4个基准在任何培训下都没有改善(表5),因此收益不是因为总体的更强模型或更好的多选择回答(附录H.2.). 全分和评价程序载于附录G.13和D。

blocks.en: 4 Does Visual Transition Reasoning Serve as a Shared Primitive?
blocks.zh: 4 视觉转型合理性是否作为共享原始服务?

blocks.zh: 图3: 域内培训数据的WOVEN监督替代方法。 每个面板在固定的2000 2{,}000-项目预算中重排一个外部基准,其中基准自身培训数据的一个共享p被选定的WOVEN子集(蓝点:3个种子;蓝线:种子平均值;波段:种子范围;灰色破折:p = 0 p{=}0;橙色破折:删除控制)的项目所取代. 取代30 30 — — 50% — — 50 % 的任务监督保持了相似的准确性;在SAT上,完全针对WOVEN的培训在扫描中得出了最高的准确性。 附录G.14载有每个基准的协议、完整的种子表和趋势统计。

blocks.en: The gains so far could still be a sum of separate effects, with each subset helping only the downstream tasks closest to its own content. For visual transition reasoning to serve as a shared training primitive, two requirements must hold:
blocks.zh: 迄今取得的成果仍然可能是各自不同效果的总和,每个子集只能帮助最接近其自身内容的下游任务. 要使视觉过渡推理成为共同的训练原始,必须有两个要求:

blocks.en: (a) Different sources improve the same capability. Every subset improves WOVEN accuracy on the action types it does not train on (§ 3.2 , Table 3 ); the capability also spans reasoning operations, as training on forward prediction alone raises counterfactual substitution and removal by 48 48 and 25 25 percentage points (Appendices G.8 and I.3 ), and it is not a shortcut (Table 94 ; Appendix H.3 ).
blocks.zh: (a) 不同来源提高同样的能力。 每个子集都提高了WOVEN对其不训练的动作类型(第3.2节,表3)的准确性;这种能力也跨越了推理操作,因为仅仅关于前向预测的培训就提出了48和25个25个百分点的反事实替代和去除(附录G.8和一.3),它不是一个捷径(表94;附录H.3)。

blocks.en: (b) The downstream gains result from that capability. If so, all subsets should improve largely the same benchmarks, and subsets that improve the capability more should transfer more. Results show that the transfer profiles of the 11 11 subsets are all positively correlated (Fig. 4 , left), so the subsets improve largely the same benchmarks (detailed analysis in Appendix G.13 ). Moreover, the more a subset improves WOVEN accuracy, the larger its average gain on the external benchmarks ( r = 0.86 r{=}0.86 ; Appendix G.13 ), as expected, and the same WOVEN format with permuted or mirrored transitions does not reproduce the downstream gains (Appendix H.1 ). Together with the specificity shown in § 3.3 , the downstream gains therefore come from the learned capability rather than from the individual subsets. We further test causality by intervention on the training data. With the training set fixed at 2,000 2{,}000 items, we replace a growing share of task-specific items with a WOVEN subset on three benchmarks (SAT ( Ray et al., 2025 ) , ActionEQA ( Bao et al., 2026 ) , and CLEVRER ( Yi et al., 2020 ) ) from three different domains, and average results over three seeds. Results show that substituting up to 30 30 – 50 % 50\% (depending on the benchmark) of the task-specific items leaves accuracy comparable to training on these items alone, and above a control that simply deletes the replaced items (Fig. 3 ; Appendix G.14 ). Transition supervision thus supplies part of what these tasks would otherwise learn from their own data, supporting the conclusion that the downstream gains result from the learned capability.
blocks.zh: (b) 国家 下游的收益来自这种能力。 如果是这样,所有子集应基本上改进相同的基准,而提高能力的子集应更多地转让。 结果显示,11个子集的转移剖面图都呈正相关(图4,左),因此子集基本上改善了相同的基准(附录G.13中的详细分析). 此外,子集越能提高WOVEN的准确性,其外部基准(r = 0.86 r = 0.86;附录G.13)的平均收益越大,而具有穿透或镜像过渡的WOVEN格式不会复制下游收益(附录H.1.). 因此,下游的收益与第3.3节所示的特异性一道,来自学到的能力,而不是单个子集。 我们通过对培训数据进行干预,进一步检验因果关系。 将培训定在2 000个2{,}000个项目,我们用三个基准(SAT(Ray等,2025年),ActionEQA)的WOVEN子集取代越来越多的特定任务项目。 (Bao等,2026年),和CLEVRER(Ii等,2020年)来自三个不同领域,平均结果为三个种子. 结果表明,以最多30-50%的50-%(取决于基准)取代特定任务项目,其准确性仅与关于这些项目的培训相当,高于简单地删除被替换项目的控制(图3;附录G.14)。 因此,过渡监督是这些任务的一部分,否则可以从它们自己的数据中学习,从而证明下游的收益来自学到的能力这一结论。

blocks.en: Together, these results establish visual transition reasoning as a shared training primitive; how its transfer is organized beyond this common component is the subject of § 5 .
blocks.zh: 这些结果共同确立了视觉过渡推理作为共享培训的原始;其转移如何组织在这一共同组成部分之外是§5的主题.

blocks.en: 5 Is There a Systematic Recipe for Training Visual World Modeling?
blocks.zh: 5 是否有用于培训视觉世界模型的系统辅助工具?

blocks.en: Sections 3 and 4 establish visual transition reasoning as a shared, trainable primitive. From the transfer profiles, error-typed analyses, and perturbation robustness of the controlled subsets, we distill a training recipe for visual world modeling in MLLMs (Fig. 1 (4)): (1) to improve a downstream task, select supervision that teaches the reasoning operation the task requires, not supervision that matches its actions, scenes, or domains; (2) for robustness, prefer supervision with large state changes, such as object manipulation over camera motion; (3) supervise temporal and agent-driven tasks directly: transfer does not cross the boundary between the temporal family and the other three, nor the boundary between passive physical events and agent-driven actions; and (4) for downstream tasks that involve no transition, such as static perception, transition supervision does not help. The following subsections give the evidence behind each item; § 5.4 tests the recipe prospectively on held-out benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 第三节和第四节将视觉过渡推理确立为共享的可训练原始. 从转移剖面图、错误类型分析以及受控子集的扰动强度来看,我们用MLLMs(图1(4))提炼出一个视觉世界模型的培训配方: (1)改进下游任务,选择指导任务所需推理操作的监督,而不是与其动作,场景,或领域相匹配的监督; (2)对于强性,偏好与大型状态变化相适应的监督,如物体操纵相机运动; (3)直接监督时空和代理驱动的任务:转移不跨越时空家族与其他三者之间的界限,也不跨越被动物理事件和代理驱动行动之间的界限; (4)对于不涉及过渡的下游任务,如静态感知,过渡监督无济于事. 以下各分节提供了每个项目背后的证据;§ 5.4 以搁置的基准对食谱进行预期测试。

blocks.en: 5.1 What Determines Where Supervision Transfers?
blocks.zh: 5.1 何以决定在何处监管转移?

blocks.en: Figure 4: Correlation of transfer profiles under the two candidate groupings. Pairwise Pearson correlation of the 11 11 subsets’ 26 26 -benchmark transfer profiles. Left: raw profiles, all pairs positive (the common component of § 4 ). Middle and right: the same residual matrix after the per-benchmark z z -score, ordered by action type and by reasoning family; only the latter produces diagonal blocks.
blocks.zh: 图4:两个候选组别下调任情况的相关性。 Pairwise Pearson 11个子集的26 26 - 基准传输配置的关联性 。 左:生剖面,所有对正(§4的共通部分). 中和正:在平分分数z-score后相同的剩余矩阵,按动作类型和推理家族来排序;只有后者产生对角块.

blocks.en: Similarity in scenes, actions, or application domains offers an intuitive basis for selecting transferable supervision. To test whether such similarity predicts downstream benefit, we compare subsets that share only an action type with those that share only a reasoning family. All transfer profiles contain the common component of § 4 , so we remove it by standardizing the gains within each benchmark, which leaves each subset’s relative pattern of benefit, and correlate these residual profiles pairwise (Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 场景、动作或应用领域的相似性为选择可转移监督提供了直观的基础。 为了检验这种相似性是否预测出下游的好处,我们比较那些只分享行动类型的子集和那些只分享推理家族的子集. 所有转移剖面图都包含第4节的共同部分,因此我们通过将每个基准内的增益标准化来删除它,这将留下每个子集的相对收益模式,并将这些剩余剖面图成对地联系起来(图4)。

blocks.en: Surprisingly, results show that subsets teaching the same reasoning family have similar residual profiles, with a mean pairwise correlation of + 0.32 +0.32 , whereas subsets sharing only an action type are no more similar than subsets sharing neither ( − 0.22 -0.22 versus − 0.23 -0.23 ), so the action shown in a transition does not predict where its supervision transfers. Moreover, the same ordering holds under three other normalizations of the gains (Fig. 4 ; Appendix G.13 ). Together with the transfer to held-out scenes (§ 3.2 ) and to external domains (§ 3.3 ), the reasoning operation a source of supervision teaches, not the actions or scenes it shows, decides which downstream tasks it helps. Recipe (1). To improve a downstream task, select supervision that teaches the reasoning operation the task requires, not supervision that matches its actions, scenes, or domains; Table 5 and Appendix G.13 list the best-transferring subset for each benchmark.
blocks.zh: 令人惊讶的是,结果显示,教同一推理家族的子集具有相近的剩余剖面,平均对等相关性为+0.32+0.32;而只分享一个动作类型的子集与共享两个功能的子集(−0.22-0.22相对于−0.23-0.23)并无更相似之处,因此过渡中显示的动作无法预测其监督转移的去向. 此外,同一命令还包含另外三项收益正常化(图4;附录G.13)。 加上转移到被搁置的场景(第3.2节)和外部域(第3.3节),一个监督来源的推理操作会教导而不是它所显示的行动或场景,决定它所帮助的下游任务. 食谱(1). 为了改进下游任务,选择指导任务所需推理操作的监督,而不是与其动作,场景或域相匹配的监督; 表5和附录G.13列出每个基准的最佳转移子集.

blocks.en: 5.2 What Makes the Learned Capability Robust?
blocks.zh: 5.2 是什么使学到的能力强大?

blocks.en:
Recipe (1) leaves the extent of state change open. We examine whether larger state changes improve robustness by comparing subsets that differ in the actions that transform the scene.
Among the causal subsets, robustness gains increase from camera motion ( + 1.7 +1.7 ) and object inspection ( + 3.0 +3.0 ) to navigation ( + 13.6 +13.6 ) and object manipulation ( + 23.2 +23.2 ), and passive physical events give the largest gain of all subsets ( + 29.9 +29.9 ; Table 3 ; Appendix G.17 ). Recipe (2). For robustness, prefer supervision with large state changes, such as object manipulation over camera motion.
blocks.zh:
食谱(1)不开放状态变化范围. 我们通过比较改变场景的行动的不同子集,来检查更大的状态变化是否提高了稳健性.
在因果子集中,强性增益从相机运动(+1.7+1.7)和物体检查(+3.0+3.0)到导航(+13.6+13.6)和物体操纵(+23.2+23.2),而被动物理事件则给予所有子集的最大增益(+29.9). +29.9;表3;附录G.17。 对于稳健性来说,更喜欢有较大状态变化的监督,如物体操纵相机运动.

blocks.en: 5.3 Where Does Transfer Break?
blocks.zh: 5.3 转移中断在哪里?

blocks.en: Table 6: Gains on the two agent-action benchmarks by non-temporal subset (percentage points over the base model; base accuracy: WorldPrediction 34.8 34.8 , ActionEQA 43.4 43.4 ). Temporal subsets are covered by (a).
blocks.zh: 表6:按非时序子集分列的两个时序行动基准的增益(比基准模型高百分点;基准精确度:世界预测34.8 34.8, ActionEQA 43.4 43.4 .)

blocks.en:
Although supervision on one reasoning operation often teaches others, as forward-dynamics supervision alone raises counterfactual substitution and removal by 48 48 and 25 25 percentage points (§ 4 ), two kinds of transition reasoning are not learned this way, nor are capabilities beyond state transitions.
(a) Temporal localization is learned only from temporal supervision: the four temporal subsets raise temporal-adjacency accuracy from 25.7 % 25.7\% to 55.6 55.6 – 58.7 % 58.7\% , whereas the seven other subsets leave it near the baseline, and supervision on temporal adjacency and on temporal ordering do not transfer to each other (Table 3 ; Appendix G.9 ). (b) Endogenous (agent-driven) transitions are not learned from exogenous supervision: the subset of passive physical events contains no agent action to learn from, and it lowers accuracy on the two benchmarks built on an agent’s action and its outcome, WorldPrediction ( − 10.2 -10.2 ) and ActionEQA ( − 1.7 -1.7 ; Table 6 ; Appendix G.13 ). Recipe (3). Supervise temporal and agent-driven tasks directly: transfer does not cross the boundary between the temporal family and the other three reasoning families, nor the boundary between passive physical events and agent-driven actions. (c) Capabilities beyond state transitions are not learned from transition supervision: the 4 4 benchmarks of static perception and general video QA do not improve under any training (Table 5 ). Recipe (4). For downstream tasks that involve no transition, transition supervision does not help.
blocks.zh:
虽然对一项推理操作的监督常常会教别人,因为仅仅前向动力学的监督就会产生48分和25分25分的反事实替代和去除(§4),但是两种过渡推理并没有用这种方式学习,能力也没有超越国家过渡.
(a) 时间局部化只从时间监督中吸取教训:四个时间分集将时间延迟精度从25.7% 25.7%提高到55.6 55.6-58.7% 58.7%,而其他七个分集则将其置于基线附近,对时间紧迫性和时间命令的监督不相互转移(表3;附录G.9)。 (b) 内生(代理人驱动的)过渡没有从外部监督中吸取教训:被动的物理事件子集没有从中吸取教训的代理人行动,它降低了基于代理人行动及其结果的两个基准(世界预测(−10.2-10.2)和ActionEQA(−1.7-1.7;表6;附录G.13)的准确性。 直接监督时间和代理驱动的任务:转移不跨越时间家族与其他三个推理家族的边界,也不跨越被动物理事件和代理驱动动作的边界. (c) 国家过渡后的能力没有从过渡监督中学习:在任何培训中,静态感知和一般视频QA的4个基准没有改善(表5)。 食谱(4). 对于不涉及过渡的下游任务,过渡监督无济于事.

blocks.en: 5.4 Can the Recipe Predict Transfer on Held-Out Benchmarks?
blocks.zh: 5.4 备用基准上的食谱预测转移能否实现?

blocks.en: Table 7: Prospective test of the recipe on held-out benchmarks. Accuracy (%), mean over 8 8 models; Δ \Delta = Recipe − - comparison mixture; Item = recipe item tested; Base = untrained model on the same questions; Set A: agent-action questions, Set B: passive-physics questions, Set C: camera-motion questions.
blocks.zh: 表7:对所持基准的食谱的预期测试。 精确度 (%),指超过8个型号; \\ Delta = Recipe - - - 比较混合物; 物品 = 食谱项目测试; Base = 同一问题上未经训练的模型; 设置 A: 代理-动作问题; 设置 B: 被动-物理问题; 设置 C: 相机-运动问题.

blocks.en:
To test the generality of our recipe, we use it to select training supervision before any training and evaluate the resulting models on external benchmarks that played no part in its derivation. For questions about agent actions and their outcomes, we compose a training mixture of WOVEN items by the recipe (Recipe) and compare it with mixtures of the same size composed in other ways: by matching the action (Camera-heavy), by a different reasoning operation (Temporal-heavy), by passive physical events (Exogenous-heavy), or with no selection (Uniform). We train Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct on each mixture with 8 8 seeds and evaluate the models on questions from MMSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , VLM4D ( Zhou et al., 2025b ) , PhysBench ( Chow et al., 2025 ) , SPAR-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , MVBench ( Li et al., 2024 ) , IntPhys 2 ( Bordes et al., 2025 ) , and CameraBench ( Lin et al., 2025 ) (Appendix J ).
Results show that all five comparisons come out as the recipe predicts (Table 7 ). On agent-action questions, the Recipe mixture exceeds the others by 1.5 1.5 to 4.7 4.7 percentage points ( p ≤ 0.03 p\leq 0.03 ), and on camera-motion questions it also outperforms the mixture matched to the camera actions ( + 0.6 +0.6 , p = 0.04 p=0.04 ), so selecting supervision by the reasoning operation matters more than matching the action. On passive-physics questions, the Exogenous-heavy mixture is ahead instead ( − 0.5 -0.5 , p = 0.04 p=0.04 ), as item (3) predicts. Our recipe therefore generalizes to new benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
为了检验我们的食谱的通俗性,我们利用它来在任何培训之前选择培训监督,并评价由此产生的外部基准模式,这些模式在计算过程中没有发挥作用。 关于代理动作及其结果的问题,我们用食谱(Repipe)制作WOVEN物品的训练混合物,并以其他方式将其与同大小的混合物相比较:将动作相匹配(Camera-havy),不同的推理操作(Temperal-havy),被动的物理事件(外向-havy),或者没有选择(Uniform). 我们用8个种子对每种混合物进行Quen2.5-VL-3B-指示,并对MMSI-Bench(杨等,2026年),VLM4D(周等,2025年b),Phys Bench的问题进行模型评价. (Chow等,2025年),SPAR-Bench (张等,2026a),MV Bench (Li等,2024年),IntPhys 2 (Bordes等,2025年),相机 Bench (Lin等,2025年)(附录J.
结果显示,所有五个比较都以食谱预测的方式出现(表7)。 关于剂-动作问题,Recipe混合物超过其他1.5至4.7 4.7个百分点(p 0.03 p\leq 0.03),而相机-运动问题也比相机动作的相配混合物强(+ 6.6+0.6,p = 0.04 p=0.04),因此通过推理操作选择监督比动作更重要. 关于被动-物理问题,外源-重力混合物位于前面(-0.5-0.5,p=0.04,p=0.04),如项目(3)所预测。 因此,我们的做法概括为新的基准。

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: World models and video priors. World models predict how a scene evolves, either in a latent space ( Hafner et al., 2025 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) or by generating video ( Brooks et al., 2024 ; Ball et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA, 2025 ) , and video models increasingly serve as simulators for planning ( Du et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) and as sources of training data for downstream learning ( Jang et al., 2025 ) . Transition-level supervision has also been used directly: state transition pretraining teaches GUI agents the forward and inverse dynamics of interface states ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , and intervention-based world-state data support controlled generation, action prediction, and policy transfer ( Cai et al., 2026 ) . WOVEN uses video-pretrained transition priors for a different purpose, as a source of controlled supervision for studying which transition reasoning MLLMs learn and reuse, which complements evaluations of rollout quality ( Huang et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA, 2025 ) and of world models on planning and interaction tasks ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Warrier et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 世界模特和视频前情提要. 世界模型预测一个场景是如何演变的,无论是在潜在空间(Hafner等人,2025年;Assran等人,2025年),还是通过产生视频(Brooks等人,2024年;Ball等人,2025年;Wan等人,2025年;NVIDIA,2025年),视频模型越来越成为规划的模拟器(Du等人,2023年;Zhou等人,2024年)并成为下游学习的培训数据来源(Jang等人,2025年)。 过渡层面的监督也直接被使用:状态过渡预训教给GUI代理者界面状态的前向和逆向动态(Liu等,2026年),基于干预的世界状态数据支持控制生成,行动预测和政策转移(Cai等,2026年). WOVEN将视频预置的过渡前科用于不同目的,作为研究MLLMs学习和再利用哪些过渡推理的受控监管来源,这补充了对推出质量的评价(Huang等人,2024年;NVIDIA,2025年)和关于规划和互动任务的世界模型的评价(Chen等人,2025年a;Warrier等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Benchmarks and supervision for multimodal reasoning. A large body of benchmarks tests MLLMs on one facet of visual change at a time: spatial reasoning under viewpoint change ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , physical and intuitive-physics reasoning ( Chow et al., 2025 ; Sreekumar and Boddeti, 2026 ; Bordes et al., 2025 ; Yi et al., 2020 ) , counterfactual reasoning about videos ( Foss et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025c ; Patel et al., 2022 ; Chinchure et al., 2025 ) , temporal ordering and localization ( Cai et al., 2024 ; Shangguan et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , and embodied and robotic question answering ( Majumdar et al., 2024 ; Bao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) , with recent suites targeting world modeling as a whole ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) . On the supervision side, synthetic data has been used to teach MLLMs spatial reasoning ( Ray et al., 2025 ) and transferable reasoning through rule-based games ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , and fully controlled scenes have been used to study what fine-tuning transfers to real images ( Rizzoli et al., 2026 ) . WOVEN relates these facets through a common ( s , a , s ′ ) (s,a,s^{\prime}) representation and controlled training comparisons, separating the reasoning operation of a task from its action and scene content, so that supervision built for one facet can be tested on every other facet and the resulting gains compared on equal terms (Appendices A.6 and A.4 ).
blocks.zh: 多式联运推理的基准和监督。 大量基准测试MLLMs在一次视觉变化的一个方面:观点变化下的空间推理(Wang等,2026a; Yang等人,2026年;Li等人,2025年a;Wang等人,2026年b),物理和直观物理推理(Chow等人,2025年;Sreekumar和Boddeti,2026年;Bordes等人,2025年;Yi等人,2020年),关于视频的反事实推理(Foss等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年c;Patel等人,2022年;Chinchure等人,2025年),时间命令和本地化(Cai等人,2024年;Shangguan等人,2024年;Liu等人,2024年),以及体现和机器人问题回答(Majumdar等人,2024年;Bao等人,2026年;Chen等人,2025年b),最近的套房以整体为目标(Go等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年a),2025年)。 在监督方面,合成数据被用于通过基于规则的游戏(Xie等,2025年)教授MLLMs空间推理(Ray等,2025年)和可转移推理(Xie等,2025年),并完全控制场景被用于研究对真实图像的微调转移(Rizzoli等,2026年). WOVEN通过共同(s, a, s ' s)(s,a, s^{\prime)的表述和受控的训练比较来将这些方面联系起来,将一项任务的推理操作与其行动和场景内容区分开来,这样,为某一方面建立的监督就可以在每一个方面进行测试,从而在平等的条件下取得收益(附录A.6和A.4)。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We used a factorized experimental design to study how the content and reasoning demands of supervision shape the acquisition and transfer of visual transition reasoning. The rollout priors and conditional generation of video generation models supplied the controlled transitions for these comparisons. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to establish visual transition reasoning as a shared training primitive in MLLMs across diverse task domains and derive a systematic training recipe from controlled comparisons of its downstream transfer. More broadly, our work paves the way for developing visual world modeling in MLLMs through reusable reasoning capabilities whose training supervision is designed by controlled experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个被分解的实验设计来研究监督的内容和推理要求如何塑造视觉过渡推理的获得和转移. 视频生成模型的推出前期和有条件生成为这些比较提供了可控过渡. 就我们所知,我们首先将视觉过渡推理确立为跨越不同任务领域的MLLMs的共享培训原始,并通过对其下游转移的控制性比较,获得系统的培训配方。 更广泛地说,我们的工作为通过可再使用的推理能力开发MLLMs的视觉世界模型铺平了道路,这些推理能力的培训监督是通过受控制的实验设计的。

blocks.en: A.1 World modeling as a cognitive primitive
blocks.zh: A.1 国家 作为认知原始的世界模型

blocks.en: This appendix unfolds the developmental, neuroscientific, and AI-program evidence that world modeling is a cognitive primitive with an intrinsic structure, established independently of any benchmark, summarized in § 1 . The point of assembling this evidence is not decorative: it is what licenses treating the two axes of § 2.2 as the primitive’s own structure rather than a decomposition we impose, and it is why the scattered external failures noted in § 1 can be read as manifestations of that structure.
blocks.zh: 本附录展现了发育,神经科学,以及AI-program的证据,证明世界建模是一种认知原始,具有内在结构,独立于任何基准之外建立,概括于§1. 收集这些证据的要点不是装饰性的:正是许可证将第2.2节的两个轴作为原始人自己的结构,而不是我们强加的分解,这就是为什么第1节中提到的分散的外部失败可以被理解为这种结构的表现。

blocks.en: Forward, inverse, and removal recover the resulting state, action, and initial state, respectively; removal asks what the scene would look like had the action not occurred, so its target is the initial state. Substitution retains the factual action and observed endpoint as evidence for the alternative outcome; its input does not include the initial state. Outcome and cued prediction share a physical prediction target but differ in the supplied principle information, such as containment. Ordering and adjacency recover global and local temporal relations within the same transition, with adjacency defined among the sampled frames. In the physical and temporal families, the action description enters the condition only when it is given.
blocks.zh: 前进,反向,和去除分别恢复所形成的状态,动作,和初始状态;去除询问如果动作没有发生,场景会是什么样子,所以它的目标是初始状态. 替代保留了事实行动和观察到的终点作为替代结果的证据;其投入不包括初始状态。 结果和提示性预测共用一个物理预测目标,但所提供的主要信息不同,如封存。 顺序和相接性在同一过渡期间恢复了全球和地方的时间关系,在被抽样的框架中界定了相接性。 在物理和时间家庭中,动作描述只有在给出时才进入条件.

blocks.en: Predicting the visual consequence of an action and inferring the action behind a state change is documented in infants from the first months of life. Spelke’s core-knowledge programme identifies object permanence, cohesion, and solidity as innate primitives ( Spelke and Kinzler, 2007 ; Spelke, 2022 ) , with violation-of-expectation paradigms (e.g., Baillargeon 1987 ) demonstrating sensitivity to physical events long before language acquisition. Counterfactual thought is a classical topic in cognitive science ( Lewis, 1973 ; Roese, 1997 ) formalized in causal inference ( Pearl, 2009 ) . The temporal structure of a single action is represented within the forward model itself: forward models predict the time course of a movement, not only its endpoint, and this trajectory representation underlies online prediction and correction ( Wolpert et al., 1995 ) . Mental simulation of physical outcomes admits computational analogues in noisy-simulation accounts ( Battaglia et al., 2013 ) .
blocks.zh: 从出生的头几个月起,婴儿就记录了一项行动的视觉后果和推断国家变化背后的行动。 Spelke的核心知识方案将物体的持久性、凝聚力和固态确定为先天原始人(Spelke和Kinzler,2007年;Spelke,2022年),在语言获取之前就已经表现出对物理事件的敏感性。 反事实思想是认知科学中的一个古典话题(Lewis, 1973;Roese,1997.) 由因果推论正式化(Pearl, 2009.). 单项行动的时间结构在前方模型本身中得到体现:前方模型预测运动的时间轨迹,而不仅仅是其终点,这种轨迹表现是在线预测和校正的基础(Wolpert等,1995年)。 物理结果的心理模拟在噪音模拟账户中认可了计算模拟(Battaglia等,2013年)。

blocks.en: Action-conditioned prediction maps onto the predictive-coding and forward-model accounts of motor and perception ( Friston, 2010 ; Wolpert et al., 1995 ) . Action-from-observation maps onto the mirror-neuron and action-understanding circuitry ( Rizzolatti et al., 2001 ) . The exo/endo dissociation distinguishes externally-triggered from self-initiated actions with distinct prefrontal signatures and behavioral dissociations ( Haggard, 2008 ; Passingham et al., 2010 ; Khalighinejad et al., 2018 ) . Within the visual system, the dorsal/ventral two-stream dissociation ( Ungerleider and Mishkin, 1982 ; Goodale and Milner, 1992 ; Milner and Goodale, 1995 ) is the structural basis for the geometric/appearance partition of the perturbation probe (§ 2.4 ).
blocks.zh: 运动和感知的预测编码和前期模型预测图(弗里斯通,2010年;Wolpert等,1995年)。 从观察到镜-中微子和动作-理解电路的动作地图(Rizzolatti等,2001年)。 exo/endo excession区分了外部触发的自发行动,有明显的前卫签名和行为分离(Haggard,2008;Passingham等,2010;Khalighiinejad等,2018). 在视觉系统内,二流分解(Ungerleider和Mishkin,1982年;Goodale和Milner,1992年;Milner和Goodale,1995年)是扰动探测器几何/出现分解的结构基础(§ 2.4)。

blocks.en: The primitive recurs under several labels: embodied planning requires forward rollout from current observation and a proposed action ( Majumdar et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Du et al., 2023 ) ; counterfactual and causal video reasoning requires reasoning over ( s , a , s ′ ) (s,a,s^{\prime}) triples under intervention on a a ( Foss et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025c ; Patel et al., 2022 ) ; mental simulation of “what-if” movement is the primary axis of recent spatial-reasoning benchmarks ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Zhou et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: 在几个标签下,原始的再现情况需要从目前的观察和拟议的行动中向前推开(Majumdar等人,2024年;Luo等人,2026年;Yang等人,2025年b;Du等人,2023年b;反事实和因果视频推理需要推论(s, a, s, a, s^{\prime}) 干预下的三重因素(Foss等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年c;Patel等人,2022年);心理模拟“什么-如果”运动是最近空间合理基准的主要轴(Wang等人,2026a; 周克等, 2025b. (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: A.2 The two axes as the intrinsic structure of the primitive
blocks.zh: 第A.2条 两轴作为原始的内在结构

blocks.en: The action and reasoning axes are not a decomposition we impose on the data; each enumerates distinctions that cognitive science documents as real and dissociable, so their cross-product is the primitive’s own structure made measurable rather than a set of principal components fit to failures.
blocks.zh: 动作和推理轴并不是我们对数据施加的分解;每个轴都列举了认知科学记录为真实和可分离的区别,所以它们的交叉产物是原始人自己的结构,它是可以衡量的,而不是一套适合失败的主要成分。

blocks.en: The operations one can perform over ( s , a , s ′ ) (s,a,s^{\prime}) are organized by three orthogonal structural properties of a predictive model. The first is causal depth: Pearl’s hierarchy separates prediction from intervention ( do ⁡ ( a ) \mathrm{do}(a) ) from counterfactual reasoning, a strictly nested ladder in which each rung expresses what the one below cannot ( Pearl, 2009 ) . Physical modeling occupies the predictive base, the passive dynamics of objects under intuitive physics ( Spelke and Kinzler, 2007 ; Battaglia et al., 2013 ) ; causal dynamics occupies the intervention rung, the visual effect of a deliberate action; counterfactual reasoning occupies the top rung, the visual scene under an action that did not occur. The second property is direction of inference, the paired internal models of sensorimotor control: a forward model predicts the consequences of an action and an inverse model recovers the action from an observed change ( Wolpert et al., 1995 ; Friston, 2010 ) , and within the counterfactual rung the analogous split is removal of an action versus its substitution by an alternative. The third property is temporal granularity: because a forward model represents the time course of a single action rather than its endpoints alone ( Wolpert et al., 1995 ) , the temporal family probes that trajectory at two grains within one transition, coarse ordering of the intermediate states and fine adjacency of consecutive ones. The eight reasoning types are the cells of these three properties, and the causal-depth nesting further predicts a difficulty ordering, physical below causal below counterfactual, that the evaluation tests directly (Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: 一个人可以完成的操作(s, a, s ) (s, a, s^{\prime})是由预测模型的三个正交结构属性所组织的. 第一是因果深度:珍珠的等级将预测与干预(做(a)\ mathrm{do}(a))与反事实推理区分开来,一个严格的嵌入式梯子,每个跑道都表达下行者无法表达的(珍珠,2009年). 物理建模占据了预测基础,直觉物理学下物体的被动动力学(Spelke and Kinzler, 2007; Battaglia等, 2013;因果动力学占据了干预跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑 第二个属性是推论方向,感官控制的对等内部模型:一个前向模型预测一个动作的后果,反向模型从所观察到的变化中恢复动作(Wolpert等,1995年;Friston,2010年),在反事实中,相似的分法是去除一个动作而代之. 第三个属性是时间颗粒性:因为前向模型代表单一行动的时间过程,而不是其终点本身(Wolpert等,1995年),时间家族探针在一次过渡中以两种谷物走出轨迹,粗糙地订购中间状态和连续状态的精确相接性. 这八种推理类型是这三种属性的细胞,而因果深度的筑巢进一步预测出一个困难顺序,物理上低于因果低于反事实,即评价直接测试(Appendix F.

blocks.en: The kinds of transition the primitive must represent track the core systems through which human cognition represents the physical world. The coarsest cut is agency: cognitive neuroscience separates externally triggered from self-initiated action with distinct prefrontal signatures ( Haggard, 2008 ; Passingham et al., 2010 ; Khalighinejad et al., 2018 ) , giving one exogenous type, the passive physics of objects, against agentic types. The exogenous type is organized by object core knowledge, with permanence, cohesion, and solidity as object primitives and gravity, support, inertia, containment, and collision as physical-event classes ( Spelke and Kinzler, 2007 ; Battaglia et al., 2013 ) . The agentic types are separated by the reference frame in which the action transforms the visual state: egocentric self-motion and object-centered transformation rely on different reference frames ( Burgess, 2006 ; Epstein et al., 2017 ) , and object-based mental rotation is behaviorally and neurally dissociable from egocentric perspective-taking, giving perceptive (egocentric viewpoint change) and inspective (object-centered examination) as distinct cells, with navigative (goal-directed locomotion) and manipulative (goal-directed action on an object) grounded in the agent core system. The five action types thus partition how a visual state can be caused to change, each a documented system rather than a label.
blocks.zh: 原始的过渡类型必须代表核心系统 人类认知通过这些系统代表物理世界 相距最相近的剪接是代理: 认知神经科学将外部触发的自发行动与有明显前缘特征的自发行动区分开来(Haggard, 2008; Passingham等, 2010; Khalighiinejad等, 2018),赋予一种外向类型,即物体的被动物理,对抗代理类型. 外来类型按物体核心知识排列,以永久、凝聚和固态作为物体原始和重力、支撑、惯性、约束和碰撞作为实体活动类别(Spelke和Kinzler,2007年;Battaglia等,2013年)。 物剂类型由作用改变视觉状态的参考框架相分离:自我中心自动机和以物体为中心的转变依赖于不同的参考框架(Burgess,2006;Epstein等,2017),以物体为基础的精神自转在行为上和神经上可以与自心取景分离,赋予知觉性(egocentre取景变化)和检查性(object-centre取景检查)作为单独的细胞,以物剂核心系统为基础,具有通航性(目标定向运动)和操纵性(目标定向在物体上的行动). 五个动作类型因此分割了一个视觉状态可以如何被引起变化,每个动作类型都有一个被记录的系统而不是标签.

blocks.en: Because the two axes are the primitive’s own degrees of freedom, any benchmark that exercises world modeling necessarily lands somewhere on their grid. Existing benchmarks each fix one axis and leave the other uncontrolled: intuitive-physics suites fix the exogenous, passive-prediction corner; spatial suites fix the perceptive and inspective actions while mixing operations; counterfactual video QA fixes the counterfactual operation while mixing actions; temporal suites fix the temporal operation. Their failures are therefore scattered marginals of one grid, which is why they look unrelated until the grid is drawn. WOVEN draws it by instantiating both axes jointly; the empirical correspondence between each external marginal and the WOVEN cell it falls in is quantified in § A.5 .
blocks.zh: 因为这两把斧头是原始人自己的自由度,任何运用世界模型的基准都必然会落在网格上某个地方。 现有基准各固定一轴,而使另一轴不受控制:直觉-物理套房固定外出,被动-预测角;空间套房在混合操作时固定感知和检查动作;反事实视频QA在混合动作时固定反事实操作;时间套房固定时间操作. 因此,他们的失败是分散在一个网格的边缘,这就是为什么在网格被绘制之前,它们看起来并不相关. WOVEN通过对两个轴的即时取出它;每个外边与它所掉入的WOVEN单元格之间的经验对应在§A.5中被量化.

blocks.en: A.3 Failure-mode triangulation across external benchmarks
blocks.zh: A.3 跨外部基准的失败三角测量

blocks.en: This appendix unfolds the three-sub-domain triangulation summarized in § 1 .
blocks.zh: 本附录将第1节所总结的三分域三分法展开.

blocks.en: Cognitive neuroscience distinguishes object identity, processed in the ventral “what” pathway, from spatial relations and viewpoint, processed in the dorsal “where” pathway ( Ungerleider and Mishkin, 1982 ; Goodale and Milner, 1992 ; Milner and Goodale, 1995 ) . The AI analogues of dorsal-stream competence are precisely the tasks on which MLLMs fail hardest: MindCube reports near-random MLLM performance on perspective-taking and “what-if” camera movement ( Wang et al., 2026a ) ; VLM4D identifies systematic failure modes on translational and rotational motion ( Zhou et al., 2025b ) ; 3DSRBench documents degraded accuracy under uncommon viewpoints ( Ma et al., 2025 ) ; COMFORT finds VLMs fail to track reference frames across perspective change ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Each is, in world-modeling terms, a forward-prediction query under a self-initiated viewpoint or navigation action.
blocks.zh: 认知神经科学从空间关系和角度区分了在通风道“什么”路径中处理的物体身份,在“何处”路径中处理(Ungerleider和Mishkin,1982年;Goodale和Milner,1992年;Milner和Goodale,1995年)。 人工智能模拟多流能力恰恰是MLLMs最失败的任务:MindCube报告近随机的MLLM在取景和“如果”相机运动方面的性能(Wang等人,2026a;VLM4D确定翻译和旋转运动的系统故障模式(Zhou等人,2025b;3DSR Bench文件在不寻常的观点下,精度下降(Ma等人,2025b;COMFORT发现VLM没有跟踪整个视角变化的参考框架(Zhang等人,2025b)。 从世界模型学的角度来看,每个问题都是在自发的观点或导航行动下进行预先预测的查询。

blocks.en: Developmental psychology documents infants’ intuitive physics, object permanence, solidity, continuity, inertia, as core knowledge emerging in the first months of life ( Spelke and Kinzler, 2007 ; Spelke, 2022 ; Baillargeon, 1987 ) . AI counterparts consistently report MLLMs at or near chance: IntPhys 2 2 shows that state-of-the-art vision models approach 50 % 50\% on violation-of-expectation items ( Bordes et al., 2025 ) ; PhysBench reports persistent MLLM shortfalls against human baselines across four physical-reasoning domains ( Chow et al., 2025 ) ; CRIPP-VQA probes counterfactual reasoning about implicit physical properties and finds comparable weakness ( Patel et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 发育心理学将婴儿的直觉物理、物体的持久性、固态性、连续性、惯性作为生命最初几个月出现的核心知识加以记录(Spelke和Kinzler,2007年;Spelke,2022年;Bailgrazion,1987年)。 IntPhys 2 2显示,最先进的视觉模型在违反预期物品上接近50%-50%-%(Bordes等人,2025年);Phys Bench报告在四个物理理性领域(Chow等人,2025年);CRIPP-VQA探测器对隐性物理特性的反事实推理,发现类似的弱点(Patel等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: Direct video-reasoning analogues, CausalVQA for physically grounded counterfactual video QA ( Foss et al., 2025 ) and MuCR for cross-modal causal-link identification ( Li et al., 2025c ) , together with the counterfactual-simulation dimension of WM-ABench ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , report systematic MLLM weakness on intervention-on-action queries.
blocks.zh: 直接的视频-推理模拟,CausalVQA用于实事求是的反事实视频QA(Foss等,2025年)和MuCR用于跨模式因果链接识别(Li等,2025年c),以及WM-A Bench的反事实-模拟维度(Gao等,2025年),报告干预-行动查询的系统性MLLM弱点.

blocks.en: Benchmarks evaluating VGMs directly on action-conditioned rollout report frontier models ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Kong et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA, 2025 ; Ball et al., 2025 ) passing well above chance: PBench evaluates world-model rollout across physics, robotics, and commonsense dimensions ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) ; VBench decomposes generation quality into 16 16 hierarchical dimensions with human-aligned metrics ( Huang et al., 2024 ) ; ChronoMagic-Bench targets metamorphic temporal evolution ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) . Downstream work assumes the world-modeling capability and exploits it as a black-box simulator: MindJourney couples a frozen VLM to a video-diffusion world model and reports an 8 % 8\% boost on SAT ( Yang et al., 2025c ) ; DreamGen distills a video world model into robot policies that generalize to 22 22 new behaviors ( Jang et al., 2025 ) ; InterPose uses VGM-hallucinated intermediate frames to outperform DUSt3R ( Cai et al., 2025 ) ; RoboDreamer ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) and VLP ( Du et al., 2023 ) exploit the same rollout capability.
blocks.zh: 直接根据行动条件下的推出模式评估自愿终止妊娠的基准报告前沿模型(Wan等人,2025年;Yang等人,2024年b;Kong等人,2025年;NVIDIA,2025年;Ball等人,2025年)远远超出机会: P Bench评价了世界模型在物理学,机器人学,和常识维度上的推广(NVIDIA,2025年;V Bench将生成质量分解为16个16个层次维度,与人相通的度量衡(Huang等,2024年;ChronoMagic-Bench目标元时间演化(Yuan等,2024年). 下游工作假设世界建模能力, MindJourney夫妇将一个被冷冻的VLM转换成一个视频扩散世界模型,并报告在SAT上提升了8%(Yang等,2025c;DreamGen将一个视频世界模型分解为将22个新行为概括化的机器人政策(Jang等,2025年);InterPose使用VGM-halluced中间帧,以超过DUST3R(Cai等,2025年);RoboDreamer (周等,2024年)和VLP(杜等,2023年)利用同名推出能力.

blocks.en: WM-ABench ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , WorldPrediction ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , WorldTest ( Warrier et al., 2026 ) , and PBench ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) target world-modeling evaluation but leave the world modeling in MLLMs question open: they aggregate across capabilities without controlling interventions on a a , treat VGMs rather than MLLMs as the subject, confine themselves to grid-world or text-only environments, or probe only a single sub-domain.
blocks.zh: WM-A Bench(高等,2025年),《世界预测》(陈等,2025年a),世界 测试(Warrier等,2026年),和P Bench(NVIDIA,2025年)的目标世界模型评价,但MLLMs中的世界模型不开放:它们集成跨能力而不控制对一个.的干预,将VGMs而不是MLLMs作为主体,局限于网格世界或文本唯一的环境,或只探测一个子域.
