blocks.en: Only the real data gains (Tables 102 – 104 ). The two matched controls fall 4.2 4.2 to 28.2 28.2 points below the real arm on every benchmark (all p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; Table 103 ), so the multiple-choice format, the answer-letter balance, multi-image input with image options, and the amount of training do not by themselves produce the gains; under circular scoring, where a letter preference earns no credit, the real arm stays above all controls. The A-OKVQA arm stays below the real arm on every benchmark and below the base model on three, so general multiple-choice training does not produce the gains either. The mirror arm learns its reversed rule: on the perceptive forward and inverse dynamics questions of the WOVEN ID test set ( 288 288 each, from sources not seen in training), it answers 85 85 – 92 % 92\% of the inverse questions by the reversed rule, whereas the permutation arm stays near chance because its mapping does not carry over to a new source (Table 105 ). The mirror arm nevertheless obtains at most a fraction of the gains, 9.4 9.4 points above the base model on SPAR-Bench and 0.9 0.9 on ActionEQA and below it on the other three benchmarks, so the gains require the correct action semantics and not only a consistent rule. On SPAR-Bench, real images in WOVEN’s inverse-dynamics format, the real arm doubles the base accuracy ( 26.4 → 54.9 26.4\to 54.9 ) while the permutation arm ( 27.5 27.5 ) and the A-OKVQA arm ( 21.8 21.8 ) stay at or below the base model and the mirror arm reaches 35.8 35.8 , so what is learned from the generated rollouts carries over to real images. Several controls fall below the base model (all three on WorldPrediction, the mirror and A-OKVQA arms on WOVEN OOD, the A-OKVQA arm on SPAR-Bench), so part of each difference in Table 103 comes from the control falling below the base model rather than from the real arm rising above it. For the perceptive causal-dynamics subset, the external gains therefore come from learned transition reasoning: they require the correct action–outcome relations and are not produced by the format or the amount of training.
blocks.zh: 只有实际数据收益(表102-104)。 两个相匹配的控件在每个基准(通页 < 0.001 p < 0.001;表103)上都低于真臂的4.2至28.2分,因此,多选择格式、答案-字母平衡、多图像输入和图像选项以及训练量本身并不产生收益;在循环评分中,如果偏好信件得不到信用,则真臂保持高于所有控制。 A-OKVQA臂在每个基准上都停留在正臂下,三个基准模型下,因此一般的多选择训练也没有产生收益. 镜臂学习了反向规则:关于WOVEN ID测试集的感知前向和反向动态问题(每个测试集288,288,来自在训练中看不到的来源),它通过倒向规则回答了85 85 — — 92 % 92 — —的反向问题,而通向臂则因为其映射没有传入到一个新的来源(表105)而保持了几近的机会. 尽管如此,镜臂最多只能得到收益的一小部分,在SPAR-Bench上比基准模型高9.4 9.4分,在ActionEQA上比0.9分,在其他三个基准下比它高0.9分,因此收益需要正确的动作语义,而不仅仅是一个一致的规则. 在SPAR-Bench上,WOVEN反向动力学格式的真实图像,正臂将底部精度(26.4~54.9 26.4\至54.9)翻了一番,而穿透臂(27.5 27.5)和A-OKVQA臂(21.8 21.8)则会停留在底部模型上或下方,而镜像臂则会达到35.8 35.8,所以从所生成的展开学得来的东西会延续到真实的图像. 若干控制都低于基准模型(WorldPresident,镜像和WOVEN OOD上的A-OKVQA臂,SPAR-Bench上的A-OKVQA臂),因此表103中的每个差异部分来自基准模型下方的控制,而不是从上升到上方的真正臂. 因此,对于感知性因果动力子集,外部收益来自学到的过渡推理:它们需要正确的行动-结果关系,而不是由培训的形式或数量产生。

blocks.en: Table 105: Content control, manipulation check: answers on WOVEN ID perceptive dynamics questions (%), per seed.
blocks.zh: 表105:内容控制,操纵检查:每个种子对WOVENID感知动态问题的回答(%).

blocks.en: H.2 Letter-balance control: circular scoring
blocks.zh: H.2 信差控制:循环评分

blocks.en: The external gains of WOVEN training remain when a letter preference earns no credit. SFT uses all four option orderings of every question and the GRPO reward penalizes an uneven answer-letter distribution (Appendix G.1 ), so WOVEN-trained models spread their answers over the letters more evenly than the base model, which prefers some letters (Table 106 ); on a benchmark whose base score is lowered by a letter preference, this alone raises accuracy. We therefore re-score with circular evaluation: each question is asked once per option rotation, so that the correct option appears at every letter once, and it counts as correct only if every rotation is answered correctly, so a model that answers without knowing the answer scores at most ( 1 / n ) n (1/n)^{n} per question ( 0.4 % 0.4\% for four options, 25 % 25\% for two) whatever its letter distribution. A gain that remains under circular scoring comes from the content of the options.
blocks.zh: WOVEN培训的外部收益在信件偏好得不到信贷时依然存在。 SFT使用每个问题的所有四个选项的顺序,GPRO奖励惩罚一个不均匀的答字母分布(Appendix G.1),因此WOVEN训练过的模型比基准模型在字母上分布得更均匀,基准模型更喜欢一些字母(表106);在一个基准上,基分被字母偏好降低,仅此就可以提高准确度. 因此,我们以循环评价的方式重新计分:每个问题每一次选项旋转一次,这样正确的选项就出现在每封信一次,只有每次旋转得到正确回答,才算正确,所以一个在不知晓答案分数的情况下回答的模型最多(1/n)n (1/n)^{n)}每个问题(4个选项0.4%.0.4%.,2个选项25%.25%.%.)。 循环评分下的一个收益来自于选项的内容.

blocks.en: We re-score the base model and four WOVEN-trained models from the main experiments, the full mixture after SFT and after SFT + GRPO and the perceptive causal-dynamics subset after SFT and after SFT + GRPO, on one benchmark per domain: SAT ( Ray et al., 2025 ) (a 150 150 -question two-option subset), ActionEQA ( Bao et al., 2026 ) ( 800 800 four-option questions), and SPAR-Bench view change ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) on ScanNet and ScanNet++ ( 261 261 four-option questions on real images, converted from the numeric questions as in Appendix J ). Decoding is greedy (vLLM) with the model asked to output only the option letter; standard scoring asks each question once with its original option order (for SAT, the accuracy over the two orders of each question). Because SAT and ActionEQA are evaluated on these subsets, the standard-scoring base scores differ from those in Table 5 . Each trained model is compared with the base model by a paired sign-flip permutation test over questions with a bootstrap 95 % 95\% confidence interval of the difference.
blocks.zh: 我们从主要实验、SFT之后和SFT + GRPO之后的全部混合物以及SFT之后和SFT + GRPO之后的感知性因果动力学子集中,将基准模型和四个WOVEN训练过的模型按每个域的基准重新进行:SAT(Ray等,2025年)(150个150个-问题2-选择子集)、ActionEQA(Bao等,2026年)(800个4-选择问题)和ScanNet和ScanNet++上的SPAR-Bench观点变化(Zhang等,2026a)(261个关于真实图像的4-选择问题,从附录J中的数字问题转换)。 解码是贪婪的(vLLM),需要的模型只输出选项字母;标准分数用原选项顺序询问每个问题一次(对于SAT,每个问题的两个顺序的准确性). 由于SAT和ActionEQA在这些子集上受到评价,标准得分基分与表5中的分分不同. 每个经过训练的模型都与基模型相提并论,通过一对相接的标志-滑行穿透测试,在问题上以95%95%的置信间隔来比较差异。

blocks.en: Table 106: Letter-balance control: answer-letter distribution (% of answers), standard scoring.
blocks.zh: 表106:字母余额控制:答字母分布 (回答百分比),标准分数.

blocks.en: Table 107: Letter-balance control: accuracy (%) under standard and circular scoring.
blocks.zh: 表107: 信差控制:标准分和循环分数下准确度(%).

blocks.en: Table 108: Letter-balance control: trained minus base, percentage points with bootstrap 95 % 95\% confidence intervals. Every difference is significant under the paired permutation test ( p ≤ 0.006 p\leq 0.006 under standard scoring; p < 0.001 p<0.001 under circular scoring).
blocks.zh: 表108: 信差控制:训练有素的减基数,百分点为靴子 95% 95-% 置信间隔。 在对接的通心试验下,每个差值都很大(标准分数下为0.006 p\leq 0.06;圆分数下为0.001 p < 0.001)。

blocks.en: Training does even out the answer letters: after training they follow the distribution of the correct answers closely (Table 106 ). Under circular scoring, all four trained models remain significantly above the base model on all three benchmarks (Tables 107 and 108 ), with larger gains than under standard scoring because the base model’s letter preference costs it more; the SFT models, trained without the balancing reward, gain as much as the SFT + GRPO models. The base model’s circular score on SPAR-Bench ( 0.4 % 0.4\% ) equals the expected score of answering without the content: its answers are determined by the option position. The external gains of WOVEN training thus remain significant when a letter preference earns no credit, after SFT and after GRPO; they cannot be attributed to the model having learned to balance its answer letters or to the multiple-choice format.
blocks.zh: 培训甚至包括答复信:培训后,它们密切跟踪正确答复的分布情况(表106)。 在循环评分下,所有四个训练有素的模型在所有三个基准(表107和108)上仍然大大高于基准模型,收益大于标准评分,因为基准模型的字母偏好成本更高;SFT模型在没有平衡奖励的情况下得到训练,收益与SFT+GPRO模型一样多. 基准模型在SPAR-Bench上的循环分数(0.4%. 0.4)等于没有内容的预期回答分数:它的答案由选项位置决定. 因此,如果在SFT之后和GRPO之后,信函偏好得不到信用,则WOVEN培训的外部收益仍然很大;这些收益不能归因于该模式学会了平衡其答复字母或者多种选择格式。

blocks.en: H.3 Shortcut control for cross-operation transfer: the unchanged-scene option
blocks.zh: H.3 交叉操作转移的快捷控制:没有变化的场景选项

blocks.en: The transfer from forward dynamics to inverse dynamics and to counterfactual reasoning within an action type does not depend on the unchanged-scene option. Training only on inspective forward dynamics questions (initial view and camera action, pick the resulting view) transfers to inverse dynamics, counterfactual substitution, and counterfactual removal of the same action type (Appendix G.8 ). Inspective questions contain an option showing the unchanged scene (the initial view, or the text “the camera remains stationary”), which is always wrong in forward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and counterfactual substitution and always correct in counterfactual removal, so part of the transfer to substitution could be a rule about that option rather than structure shared across reasoning types. We remove the option from the forward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and substitution questions, which become three-option questions (chance 33.3 % 33.3\% ) on which avoiding it no longer helps, and evaluate removal in its original form, where the unchanged scene is the correct answer and a model that avoids it would fall below the base model.
blocks.zh: 从前向动态向倒向动态的转移,以及在动作类型中反向事实推理的转移,并不取决于不变-场景选项. 只就检查性前向动力学问题(初始视图和相机动作,选取由此而来的观点)向反向动力学转移,反事实替代,并反事实去除同一种动作类型(附录G.8. 观察问题包含一个选项,显示没有变化的场景(初始观点,或文字"相机保持静止"),这在前向动力学,反向动力学和反事实取而代之总是是错误的,在反事实取而代之时总是正确的,因此部分向取而代之的转移可能是关于该选项的规则,而不是各种推理类型共享的结构. 我们从前向动态,反向动态,和替代问题中去掉这个选项,这些选项成为了三个选项问题(chance 33.3% 33.3\% \%),对此回避已经无济于事,并以原始形式评价去除,其中不变的场景是正确答案,避免掉入底模的模型.

blocks.en: The model is Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct trained only on inspective forward dynamics ( 1,020 1{,}020 questions, each in its four option orderings, 4,080 4{,}080 training examples) in one run, with LoRA (rank 16 16 , α = 32 \alpha=32 , dropout 0.05 0.05 ), learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 3 3 epochs, final checkpoint, compared with the untrained base model; this configuration differs from that of Appendix G.8 , so the gains differ in size. Evaluation uses the WOVEN ID inspective questions, 270 270 per reasoning type, with greedy decoding (vLLM) and the model asked to output only the option letter; in the static-free versions the remaining options are relabeled A–C in their original order. Differences (forward-only − - base) are tested by a paired sign-flip permutation test over questions with a bootstrap 95 % 95\% confidence interval.

The transfer from forward dynamics to inverse dynamics and to counterfactual reasoning within an action type therefore does not depend on that option.

blocks.en: Appendix I Robustness and consistency of the results
blocks.zh: 附录一 结果的强性和一致性

blocks.en: This section checks the best-subset gains against selection and seed variation (Appendix I.1 ), repeats the training on a different model family (Appendix I.2 ), and tests whether forward and inverse queries about the same transition succeed together after training (Appendix I.3 ).

blocks.en: I.1 Selection and seed robustness of the best-subset gains
blocks.zh: 一.1 最佳次级收益的选择和种子稳健性

blocks.en: The best-subset gains on representative benchmarks of every capability domain are neither an artifact of selecting the best of 22 22 candidates nor of a single training seed. The controlled-subset result reports, for each benchmark, the best of the 11 11 subsets after SFT and after GRPO ( 22 22 candidates); taking the maximum of many candidates can produce a gain of a few points by selection alone, and a single training run can produce a gain by seed variation alone. To check both, we ran two additional GRPO seeds for every subset ( 3 3 in total) and selected two representative benchmarks for each capability domain of § 3 : SAT and ViewSpatial (spatial), ActionEQA and Robo2VLM (embodied), InPhyRe and CLEVRER (physical), WorldPrediction and WM-ABench (procedural and world-model prediction), and TempCompass and TemporalBench (long) (temporal). Scores are recomputed from the model outputs under each benchmark’s official protocol (Table 111 ); GRPO scores are per-unit means over the 3 3 GRPO seeds, so the best candidate and its gain can differ from the single reported checkpoint in Table 5 . The selection check compares the best gain among the 22 22 candidates with the distribution of the best gain that selection alone produces: per evaluation unit, the 22 22 differences from the base model are sign-flipped jointly, the 22 22 gains are recomputed, and their maximum is taken ( 10,000 10{,}000 flips); Holm correction over the 22 22 candidates is reported as well. The seed check evaluates the best subset after GRPO separately for each of its 3 3 seeds against the base model (paired sign-flip test, 10,000 10{,}000 flips).
blocks.zh: 在每个能力领域的代表性基准上取得的最佳次级成果既不是22名候选人中最佳人选,也不是单一培训种子。 受控子集结果报告,每个基准,SFT之后和GRPO之后的11个子集(22个候选人)中最好的一个;取出最多许多候选人,单靠选拔就能产生几分的得分,单次训练单跑就能通过种子变异产生得分. 为了检查这两种情况,我们为每个子集(总共3个)另外运行了两个GRPO种子,并为第3节的每个能力领域选择了两个代表性基准:SAT和Videaspatial(空间)、ActionEQA和Robo2VLM(体能)、InPhyre和CLEVRER(物理)、世界预测和WM-A Bench(程序和世界模型预测)以及TemperCompass和Temperal Bench(长)。 得分从每个基准官方协议的模型输出(表111)中重新计算出来;GRPO的分数是单位分数,代表3个GRPO种子,因此,最佳候选人及其收益可能不同于表5中报告的单一检查站。 甄选检查将22名候选人中的最佳收益与甄选本身产生的最佳收益的分配相比较:每个评价单位,与基准模式的22个22个差异是共同标出,22个22个收益是重算的,最多是10 000个10{}000个翻转; 还报告了对22名候选人的整改情况。 种子检查在GRPO之后,针对其3个种子中的每个种子分别进行最佳子集评价(paired sign-flip test,10,000 10{,}000 flips).

blocks.en: I.2 Generalization across model families
blocks.zh: 一.2 模范家庭概况

blocks.en: The effect of WOVEN training holds across model families. The main experiments train Qwen2.5-VL; we repeat the training on Gemma-3-4B-it ( Team et al., 2025a ) , which has a different vision encoder and a different way of handling multiple images, and compare with the untrained Gemma-3-4B-it. Training uses the WOVEN perceptive causal-dynamics subset (forward and inverse dynamics questions, four option orderings, 9,750 9{,}750 training examples) with LoRA (rank 16 16 , α = 32 \alpha=32 , dropout 0.05 0.05 ) on the language model’s q/k/v/o projections, vision encoder and multimodal projector frozen, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 5 % 5\% warmup, cosine schedule, effective batch size 64 64 , 3 3 epochs, final checkpoint, with 3 3 seeds. Evaluation uses greedy decoding (vLLM) with the model asked to output only the option letter, on WOVEN ID ( 6,228 6{,}228 questions), WOVEN OOD ( 3,496 3{,}496 held-out-scene questions), SPAR-Bench view change ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) on ScanNet and ScanNet++ ( 261 261 questions with two real images, asking how the camera moved between them, converted to four options as in Appendix J ), and SAT ( Ray et al., 2025 ) ( 150 150 two-option questions, scored circularly: each question is asked once with each option order and counts as correct only if both answers are right). For each question, the score of the trained model is averaged over the 3 3 seeds and compared with the base model by a paired sign-flip permutation test over questions, with a bootstrap 95 % 95\% confidence interval of the difference. Table 115 reports the same training and evaluation on Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct for reference; because the training configuration and the decoding protocol differ from those of the main experiments, these Qwen scores differ from the corresponding scores in the main text.

blocks.en: I.3 Consistency between forward and inverse dynamics
blocks.zh: 一.3. 前向和逆向动态的一致性

blocks.en: After WOVEN training, the forward and inverse queries about the same transition succeed and fail together, whereas for the base model they are independent, so the two reasoning operations draw on one shared mapping between states, actions, and outcomes rather than on two separate skills. Training raises accuracy on both forward dynamics (initial state and action, predict the outcome) and inverse dynamics (initial state and outcome, identify the action); the two could improve independently. We therefore query every transition ( s , a i , s i ′ ) (s,a_{i},s^{\prime}_{i}) of the WOVEN ID test set twice, by the forward question for a i a_{i} and by the inverse question for s i ′ s^{\prime}_{i} ( 1,134 1{,}134 pairs from 306 306 sources, all ID transitions that have both questions), and compare the rate at which both are answered correctly (joint) with the rate expected if the two were independent, P ⁡ ( forward correct ) × P ⁡ ( inverse correct ) P(\text{forward correct})\times P(\text{inverse correct}) , computed within each action type and weighted by the number of pairs so that differences in difficulty between action types cannot produce a correlation. We also report the cycle rate, the share of transitions for which the inverse question about the outcome the model itself picked in the forward question returns the original action a i a_{i} . GRPO values are averaged over 3 3 GRPO seeds; 95 % 95\% confidence intervals are by bootstrap over sources ( 2,000 2{,}000 resamples).
blocks.zh: 在WOVEN训练后,关于同一过渡的前向和倒向的询问一起成功和失败,而对于基础模型来说,它们是独立的,因此两个推理操作借鉴了各州,行动和结果之间的一个共享绘图,而不是两个独立的技能. 培训提高了前进动态(初始状态和行动,预测结果)和逆动态(初始状态和结果,确定行动)的准确性;两者可以独立改进。 因此,我们对WOVEN ID测试中两次设定的每个过渡(s, ai, si') (s, a_{i}, s^{\prime}_{i}), 即一个i a_{i}的先行问题和 s i s^{\prime}_{i} (1,134 1{, } 134对来自306 306 个源的倒数, 所有ID 的过渡都有问题) 进行质询, 并将两者得到正确(联合)的回答的比率与如果两者是独立的预期的速率进行比较, P⁡ (向前正确) → P⁡ (倒数正数正数正数正数正数正数正数正数), 在每个动作类型内计算,使动作类型之间的难度差异不能产生关联。 我们还报告周期率, 转换比例, GRPO值平均为3个3个GRPO种子;95%的95-%的置信间隔是用靴子取自源头(2,000 2{,}000个复标)。

blocks.en: Table 116: Forward and inverse consistency on WOVEN ID (%). blocks.en: For the base model, success on the forward and the inverse question of a transition is independent (excess − 0.1 -0.1 , confidence interval including 0 0 ). After training on causal or counterfactual transitions, the two queries of the same transition succeed together more often than independence predicts, for every trained model (excess + 0.4 +0.4 to + 4.5 +4.5 , every confidence interval above 0 0 ); the full-mixture models are close to ceiling on both queries (at least 94.8 % 94.8\% ), which leaves little room for excess. The cycle rate, where the inverse query recovers the action behind the outcome the model itself predicted, rises from 19.0 % 19.0\% to 45 45 – 94 % 94\% (Table 116 ).
blocks.zh: 就基准模型而言,前进的成功和倒向的过渡问题是独立的(过度-0.1-0.1,信任间隔包括0 0)。 在接受因果或反事实过渡培训后,同一过渡的两个查询比独立预测更经常地成功,对于每一个经过训练的模型(过量+0.4+0.4到+4.5+4.5,每个置信间隔都超过0;完全混合模式在两个查询上接近上限(至少94.8%94.8+%)),这几乎没有多余的余地. 循环率,即反向查询恢复模型本身预测结果背后的动作,从19.0% 19.0 % 上升到45 % – 94 % 94 % (表116 ).

blocks.en: Appendix J Prospective validation of the training recipe
blocks.zh: 附录J 培训方法的预期验证

blocks.en: Goal. The recipe in § 5 is distilled from transfer results on the 26 26 benchmarks. The prospective test fixes training mixtures by the recipe before training and compares them with other mixtures of the same size on questions from external benchmarks that were not used to derive the recipe. Every comparison asks how a fixed training budget should be allocated: all mixtures start from the same base model and are trained with the same protocol, so the base model enters none of the comparisons; its scores are reported for reference.
blocks.zh: 进球了 第5款中的食谱取自26个基准的转让结果。 未来测试在培训前通过配方确定培训混合物,并在外部基准中未用来得出配方的问题上将其与其他大小相同的混合物进行比较。 每一次比较都问如何分配固定的培训预算:所有混合物都从同一个基准模型开始,并经过同样的协议培训,因此基准模型没有输入任何比较;其分数报告以供参考。

blocks.en: Training. Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct, single-stage SFT with LoRA (rank 16 16 , α = 32 \alpha=32 , dropout 0.05 0.05 ), learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 5 % 5\% warmup, 3 3 epochs. The WOVEN training set is partitioned into the 11 11 controlled subsets of § 3 , one per combination of action type and reasoning family. Each model is trained on 1,500 1{,}500 WOVEN items drawn from these subsets, each item with its four option orderings, about 7,000 7{,}000 training examples in total. The five mixtures differ only in how the 1,500 1{,}500 items are allocated across the 11 11 subsets (Table 117 ). Each mixture is trained with 8 8 seeds, where the seed determines which items are drawn and the training order, 40 40 models in total.
blocks.zh: 培训。 Quen2.5-VL-3B-指令,单相 SFT与LORA(排名16 16,α = 32\alpha = 32,辍学率0.05 0.05),学习率10 − 4 10^{-4},5% 5% = 暖和,3个时代. WOVEN训练集被分为11个控制的子集 第3节,每个组合动作类型和推理家族. 每个模型都从这些子集中取出1,500 1{,}500个WOVEN项目,每个项目有四个选项订单,总共约7,000 7{,} 000个培训实例。 这5种混合物仅在1,500个1{,}500个物品如何在11个子集之间分配上有所不同(表117)。 每种混合物都经过8个8个种子的训练,种子决定取出哪些物品和训练顺序,总共40个型号。

blocks.zh: 表117:预期试验:每种混合物中每个子集的培训项目数量(1 500 1{,}500个)。

blocks.en: Mixtures. The target questions of the main comparisons (Set A below) ask for the outcome of an agent’s action or for the action behind an observed change, that is, they call for causal and counterfactual reasoning about agent-driven transitions. By item (1) of the recipe, the Recipe mixture allocates 82 % 82\% of the budget to the six agent-action subsets of the causal and counterfactual families; by item (3), temporal and passive-physical supervision does not transfer to such questions, so the remaining five subsets keep 52 52 – 54 54 items each. Each comparison mixture represents another way of selecting supervision: Camera-heavy selects by matching the action (the camera-motion and object-inspection subsets, across reasoning families); Temporal-heavy selects the wrong reasoning operation (the temporal subsets); Uniform makes no selection (equal shares over the 11 11 subsets); Exogenous-heavy is dominated by passive physical events.
blocks.zh: 杂相. 主要比较的目标问题(下文A节)要求了解代理人的行动结果或观察到的变化背后的行动,即要求就代理人驱动的过渡进行因果关系和反事实推理。 食谱第(1)项规定,食谱混合物将预算的82%的82分拨给因果和反事实家族的六个代理动作子集;第(3)项规定,时间和被动物理监督不转至此类问题,所以其余五个子集保留52个-54个. 每种比较混合物是选择监督的另一种方式: 相机重度通过匹配动作(相机-运动和对象-检查子集,跨推理家族)进行选择; 相机重度选择错误推理操作(时间子集); 制服不选择(在11个子集中持平); 外相重度以被动物理事件为主.

blocks.en: Evaluation questions. All questions are drawn from external benchmarks, MMSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , VLM4D ( Zhou et al., 2025b ) , PhysBench ( Chow et al., 2025 ) , SPAR-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , MVBench ( Li et al., 2024 ) , IntPhys 2 ( Bordes et al., 2025 ) , and CameraBench ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , none of which is among the 26 26 benchmarks used to derive the recipe. Decoding is greedy (vLLM), and the model is asked to output only the option letter. The questions are grouped by what each comparison requires of them. Recipe versus Temporal-heavy, Uniform, and Exogenous-heavy require only that the questions call for causal or counterfactual reasoning about an agent’s action (Set A). The other direction of item (3) requires questions about passive physical events (Set B). Recipe versus Camera-heavy asks whether matching the reasoning operation or matching the action matters more, so it is run on questions whose action Camera-heavy matches, with the action fixed to camera motion (Set C). Item (4) requires static questions that involve no change (Set D).
blocks.zh: 评价问题。 所有问题都取自外部基准,MMSI-Bench(杨等,2026年),VLM4D(周等,2025b),Phys Bench. (Chow等,2025年),SPAR-Bench (张等,2026年a),MV Bench (Li等,2024年),IntPhys 2 (Bordes等,2025年),相机 Bench (Lin等,2025年),均不在用于得出食谱的26个基准中. 解码很贪婪(vLLM),要求模型只输出选项字母. 这些问题按每项比较的要求分类。 食谱与临时重物、制服和外生重物只需问题要求对代理人的行为进行因果关系或反事实推理(A组)。 第(3)项的另一方向要求提出被动物理事件的问题(B组)。 道具与相机-重相机询问是匹配推理操作还是匹配动作更重要,因此它运行在动作相机-重相机匹配的问题上,和固定在相机运动上的动作(Set C). 项目(4)要求静态问题不涉及任何变化(第D组)。

blocks.en: Set A, agent-action questions ( 1,673 1{,}673 ). All require the outcome of an action or the motion behind a change; the action type is not restricted (Table 118 ). The score is the accuracy on each subset, averaged with equal weight over the five subsets. The PhysBench questions come from a sample of 1,001 1{,}001 PhysBench questions stratified by category.

blocks.en: Set C, camera-motion questions ( 7,592 7{,}592 ). In every subset the action is the camera’s own motion, which corresponds to WOVEN’s perceptive actions, and the reasoning is to infer how the camera moved from the observations (inverse dynamics; Table 120 ). The 74 74 MMSI-Bench questions also belong to Set A. For SPAR view change, the original questions ask for the camera’s translation and rotation as numbers and are converted to four-option questions: the correct option is the motion the camera actually made (a turn of at least 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} , or, with a turn of at most 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} , a translation of at least 0.6 0.6 m in a single direction), and the three wrong options are motions that clearly did not happen, including the opposite of the correct one. The CameraBench questions are the yes/no questions of the CameraBench VQA release, grouped by the camera motion they ask about, with 8 8 frames sampled uniformly from each video. The score is the accuracy over all questions.

blocks.en: Results. Table 7 reports the five comparisons; in every comparison both mixtures score above the untrained base model. Selecting the wrong reasoning operation costs 3.5 3.5 points (Temporal-heavy) and selecting passive physical events costs 4.7 4.7 points (Exogenous-heavy); making no selection costs 1.5 1.5 points (Uniform). On camera-motion questions, Camera-heavy holds more exact-match supervision than Recipe ( 735 735 versus 620 620 items in the camera-motion and object-inspection subsets of the causal and counterfactual families) and still trails by 0.6 0.6 points ( p = 0.04 p=0.04 ); the two mixtures differ in the remaining budget, which Camera-heavy spends on same-action temporal subsets ( 490 490 items) and Recipe on same-operation navigation and manipulation subsets ( 618 618 items). On passive-physics questions, Exogenous-heavy scores 0.5 0.5 points above Recipe ( p = 0.04 p=0.04 ), consistent with the direction of item (3). In the other direction, Exogenous-heavy gains least on Set A (Table 121 ), consistent with § 5.3 : passive-physical supervision contributes least to agent-action questions. Its small gain is attributable to the 405 405 items ( 27 % 27\% ) it draws from agent-action subsets, whereas § 5.3 uses the passive-physical subset alone.

blocks.en: WOVEN deliberately scopes to world modeling, single-step, vision-grounded, action-conditioned reasoning over ( s t , a , s t + 1 ) (s_{t},a,s_{t+1}) triples, and therefore does not directly evaluate the broader world-model lineages: long-horizon procedural planning over abstract action sequences ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , symbolic-environment dynamics inference ( Warrier et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , and purely latent-space predictive representations evaluated by downstream control rather than per-cell attribution ( Hafner et al., 2025 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) . These programmes operate over distinct state spaces and admit different yardsticks; extending the cell-level statistical-attribution methodology to them is a natural follow-up but outside the present scope.
blocks.zh: WOVEN有意将世界模型、单步、有远见、有行动条件的推理范围扩大到三进制(st, a, st + 1)(s_{t}, a, s_{t+1}),因此不直接评价更广泛的世界示范线:对抽象行动序列(Chen等,2025年a)的长范围程序规划、象征环境动态推论(Warrier等,2026年;Chen等,2026年),以及由下游控制而不是单细胞归属评估的纯粹潜在空间预测表述(Hafner等,2025年;Asran等,2025年)。 这些方案在不同的国家空间运作,并承认不同的尺度;扩大细胞一级的统计分配方法是一种自然的后续行动,但超出了目前的范围。
